senses.definition_vi: một lá thư hoặc tuyên bố chính thức rằng ai đó sẽ phù hợp cho một công việc cụ thể, v.v.

senses.definition: the process of changing or improving the condition of something or the way it works; the process of putting something back into the state it was in before

examples.x: the reconstruction of the educational system
the post-war reconstruction of Germany
a reconstruction period

senses.definition_vi: quá trình thay đổi hoặc cải thiện tình trạng của một cái gì đó hoặc cách nó hoạt động; quá trình phục hồi lại một cái gì đó về trạng thái trước đây

senses.definition: the activity of building again something that has been damaged or destroyed

examples.x: the reconstruction of the sea walls

senses.definition_vi: hoạt động xây dựng lại một cái gì đó đã bị hư hại hoặc phá hủy

senses.definition: a copy of something that no longer exists

examples.x: The doorway is a nineteenth-century reconstruction of Norman work.

senses.definition_vi: một bản sao của một cái gì đó không còn tồn tại

senses.definition: an act of acting out events that are known to have happened, in order to try and get more information or better understanding about what happened, especially a crime

examples.x: Last night police staged a reconstruction of the incident.
The police have staged a reconstruction of the events leading up to the murder.

senses.definition_vi: hành động diễn lại các sự kiện đã biết đã xảy ra, để cố gắng có thêm thông tin hoặc hiểu rõ hơn về những gì đã xảy ra, đặc biệt là một tội phạm

senses.definition: (in the US) the period after the Civil War when the southern states returned to the US and laws were passed that gave rights to African Americans
senses.definition_vi: (ở Mỹ) giai đoạn sau Nội chiến khi các bang miền Nam trở lại Hoa Kỳ và các luật được ban hành trao quyền cho người Mỹ gốc Phi

senses.definition: a written account of something that is kept so that it can be looked at and used in the future

examples.x: You should keep a record of your expenses.
medical/dental records
It was the worst flood since records began.
According to official records, there were 21 murders in the city that year.
Last summer was the wettest on record.
people who leave no trace in the historical record (= written documents that provide evidence about the past)

senses.definition_vi: một ghi chép bằng văn bản về một điều gì đó được lưu giữ để có thể xem xét và sử dụng trong tương lai

senses.definition: the best result or the highest or lowest level that has ever been reached, especially in sport

examples.x: She holds the world record for the 100 metres.
to break the record (= to achieve a better result than there has ever been before)
to set a new record
There was a record number of candidates for the post.
I got to work in record time.
The UK's biggest banks made record profits last year.
Unemployment has reached a record high (= the highest level ever).

senses.definition_vi: kết quả tốt nhất hoặc mức cao nhất hoặc thấp nhất từng đạt được, đặc biệt là trong thể thao

senses.definition: the facts that are known about somebody/something’s past behaviour, character, achievements, etc.

examples.x: The airline has a good safety record.
The report criticizes the government's record on housing.
He has an impressive record of achievement.

senses.definition_vi: các sự kiện được biết về hành vi, tính cách, thành tích, v.v. trong quá khứ của ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: rocks, fossils, the parts of buildings and objects found in the ground, etc. that provide evidence about the past

examples.x: Fossil records suggest that the region was covered in water until relatively recently.
evidence in the geological record
This period of barbarian rule is poorly represented in the archaeological record.

senses.definition_vi: đá, hóa thạch, các bộ phận của tòa nhà và đồ vật được tìm thấy trong lòng đất, v.v. cung cấp bằng chứng về quá khứ

senses.definition: the fact of having committed crimes in the past

examples.x: Does he have a record?
teenagers with a criminal record

senses.definition_vi: việc đã phạm tội trong quá khứ

senses.definition: a thin, round piece of plastic on which music, etc. is recorded

examples.x: to play a record
a record collection

senses.definition_vi: một miếng nhựa tròn mỏng ghi nhạc, v.v.

senses.definition: a piece or collection of music released as a record, or on CD, the internet, etc.

examples.x: a record company (= one which produces and sells records)
They released their first record in 1963.
The band had a hit record in 1973.
His new record is available on CD or as a download.

senses.definition_vi: một bản nhạc hoặc bộ sưu tập nhạc được phát hành dưới dạng đĩa nhạc, hoặc trên CD, internet, v.v.

senses.definition: used to show that you want what you are saying to be officially written down and remembered

examples.x: Just for the record I would like to clarify something my colleague said earlier.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để cho thấy bạn muốn những gì bạn đang nói được ghi lại chính thức và ghi nhớ

senses.definition: used to emphasize a point that you are making, so that the person you are speaking to takes notice

examples.x: And, for the record, he would be the last person I'd ask.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh một điểm bạn đang đưa ra, để người bạn đang nói chuyện chú ý

senses.definition: in a way that keeps repeating a statement or opinion in an annoying way

examples.x: I hate sounding like a broken record, but I have to say again, we must do more to help.

senses.definition_vi: theo cách lặp đi lặp lại một tuyên bố hoặc ý kiến một cách khó chịu

senses.definition: something that has been recorded as being true
senses.definition_vi: điều gì đó đã được ghi nhận là đúng.

senses.definition: if you tell somebody something off the record, it is not yet official and you do not want them to repeat it publicly

examples.x: Strictly off the record, some members of staff will have to be made redundant.

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn nói với ai đó điều gì đó ngoài biên bản, thì nó chưa chính thức và bạn không muốn họ lặp lại nó công khai.

senses.definition: to say something publicly or officially so that it may be written down and repeated

examples.x: He didn't want to go on the record as either praising or criticizing the proposal.
I should like to place on record my sincere thanks to all those who have given support.

senses.definition_vi: nói điều gì đó công khai hoặc chính thức để nó có thể được ghi lại và lặp lại.

senses.definition: to give people the correct information about something in order to make it clear that what they previously believed was in fact wrong

examples.x: To put the record straight, I do not support that idea and never have done.

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp cho mọi người thông tin chính xác về điều gì đó để làm rõ những gì họ tin trước đó thực sự sai.

senses.definition: to keep a permanent account of facts or events by writing them down, filming them, storing them in a computer, etc.

examples.x: Her childhood is recorded in the diaries of those years.
You should record all your expenses during your trip.
His job is to record how politicians vote on major issues.
She recorded in her diary that they crossed the Equator on 15 June.
It is recorded that, by the year 630, four hundred monks were attached to the monastery.

senses.definition_vi: giữ một bản ghi vĩnh viễn về các sự kiện hoặc sự kiện bằng cách viết chúng xuống, quay phim chúng, lưu trữ chúng trên máy tính, v.v.

senses.definition: to make a copy of music, a film, etc. or to convert sound or a performance into a permanent form, so that you can listen to or watch it again

examples.x: Did you remember to record that programme for me?
a recorded concert
Tell me when the machine starts recording.
He recorded the class rehearsing before the performance.

senses.definition_vi: tạo một bản sao của âm nhạc, phim, v.v. hoặc chuyển đổi âm thanh hoặc một buổi biểu diễn thành một hình thức vĩnh viễn, để bạn có thể nghe hoặc xem lại nó.

senses.definition: to perform music so that it can be copied, stored and played back

examples.x: The band is back in the US recording their new album.
to record a song
They spent the summer touring and recording.

senses.definition_vi: biểu diễn âm nhạc để nó có thể được sao chép, lưu trữ và phát lại.

senses.definition: to make an official or legal statement about something

examples.x: The coroner recorded a verdict of accidental death.
It is with great regret that we record the death of one of our founder members.

senses.definition_vi: đưa ra một tuyên bố chính thức hoặc pháp lý về điều gì đó.

senses.definition: to show a particular measurement or amount

examples.x: The thermometer recorded a temperature of 40°C.

senses.definition_vi: chỉ ra một phép đo hoặc số lượng cụ thể.

senses.definition: to achieve a particular score or result

examples.x: The team recorded their first win of the season.
to record a victory/high score

senses.definition_vi: đạt được một điểm số hoặc kết quả cụ thể.

senses.definition: sound or pictures that have been recorded on computer files or on CD, DVD, video, etc.

examples.x: an audio recording
a sound/live recording
He continued to make recordings with all of these orchestras.
a video recording of the wedding
recordings by various artists
The hijackers can be heard clearly on the recording stating their demands.

senses.definition_vi: âm thanh hoặc hình ảnh đã được ghi lại trong các tệp máy tính hoặc trên CD, DVD, video, v.v.

senses.definition: the process of making a record, film, radio or television show, etc.

examples.x: during the recording of the show
recording equipment
a recording studio/session/artist
the recording industry (= the industry that records and sells music)
We'll be entering a London studio to start recording in June.

senses.definition_vi: quá trình tạo ra một bản ghi, phim, chương trình radio hoặc truyền hình, v.v.

senses.definition: the process or act of writing down and storing information for official purposes

examples.x: the recording of financial transactions
an accurate recording of time
a detailed recording of facts

senses.definition_vi: quá trình hoặc hành động ghi lại và lưu trữ thông tin cho mục đích chính thức.

senses.definition: to tell somebody about something, especially something that you have experienced

examples.x: She was asked to recount the details of the conversation to the court.
They recounted what had happened during those years.
‘It was before the war,’ he recounted.

senses.definition_vi: kể cho ai đó nghe về điều gì đó, đặc biệt là điều gì đó mà bạn đã trải qua.

senses.definition: to get well again after being ill, hurt, etc.

examples.x: He's still recovering from his operation.
She spent many weeks in hospital recovering from her injuries.
He has fully recovered from the shoulder surgery.
She remains in serious condition, but is expected to recover.
The victim is recovering well at home.

senses.definition_vi: khỏe lại sau khi bị ốm, bị thương, v.v.

senses.definition: to return to a normal state after an unpleasant or unusual experience or a period of difficulty

examples.x: It can take many years to recover from the death of a loved one.
The economy is at last beginning to recover.

senses.definition_vi: trở lại trạng thái bình thường sau một trải nghiệm khó chịu hoặc bất thường hoặc một giai đoạn khó khăn.

senses.definition: to get back the same amount of money that you have spent or that is owed to you

examples.x: He is unlikely to ever recover his legal costs.

senses.definition_vi: lấy lại cùng một số tiền mà bạn đã chi tiêu hoặc số tiền nợ bạn.

senses.definition: to get back or find something that was lost, stolen or missing

examples.x: The police eventually recovered the stolen paintings.
Six bodies were recovered from the wreckage.

senses.definition_vi: lấy lại hoặc tìm thấy thứ gì đó đã bị mất, bị đánh cắp hoặc bị thiếu.

senses.definition: to win back a position, level, status, etc. that has been lost

examples.x: The team recovered its lead in the second half.

senses.definition_vi: giành lại một vị trí, cấp độ, địa vị, v.v. đã bị mất.

senses.definition: to get back the use of your senses, control of your emotions, etc.

examples.x: It took her a few minutes to recover consciousness.
to recover your sight
She seemed upset but quickly recovered herself.

senses.definition_vi: lấy lại khả năng sử dụng các giác quan, kiểm soát cảm xúc, v.v.

senses.definition: the process of becoming well again after an illness or injury

examples.x: My father has made a full recovery from the operation.
to make a remarkable/quick/speedy/slow recovery
She is on the road to (= making progress towards) recovery.

senses.definition_vi: quá trình khỏe lại sau khi bị ốm hoặc bị thương.

senses.definition: the process of improving or becoming stronger again

examples.x: The government is forecasting an economic recovery.
The economy is showing signs of recovery.
a recovery in consumer spending

senses.definition_vi: quá trình cải thiện hoặc trở nên mạnh mẽ hơn trở lại.

senses.definition: the action or process of getting something back that has been lost or stolen

examples.x: There is a reward for information leading to the recovery of the missing diamonds.

senses.definition_vi: hành động hoặc quá trình lấy lại thứ gì đó đã bị mất hoặc bị đánh cắp.

senses.definition: the room in a hospital where patients are kept immediately after an operation

examples.x: Your mother is now in recovery.
After the operation she was taken to the recovery room.

senses.definition_vi: căn phòng trong bệnh viện nơi bệnh nhân được giữ ngay sau phẫu thuật.

senses.definition: a person who has recently joined the armed forces or the police

examples.x: the training of new recruits
He spoke of us scornfully as raw recruits (= people without training or experience).

senses.definition_vi: một người vừa mới gia nhập lực lượng vũ trang hoặc cảnh sát.

senses.definition: a person who joins an organization, a company, etc.

examples.x: They are stepping up attempts to attract new recruits to the nursing profession.

senses.definition_vi: một người tham gia một tổ chức, một công ty, v.v.

senses.definition: to find new people to join a company, an organization, the armed forces, etc.

examples.x: We are trying to recruit officers from more diverse backgrounds.
He's responsible for recruiting at all levels.
They recruited several new members to the club.
They recruited more staff to deal with the complaints.

senses.definition_vi: tìm kiếm những người mới để tham gia một công ty, một tổ chức, lực lượng vũ trang, v.v.

senses.definition: to persuade somebody to do something, especially to help you

examples.x: We were recruited to help peel the vegetables.

senses.definition_vi: thuyết phục ai đó làm điều gì đó, đặc biệt là để giúp bạn.

senses.definition: to form a new army, team, etc. by persuading new people to join it

examples.x: to recruit a task force

senses.definition_vi: thành lập một đội quân mới, một đội, v.v. bằng cách thuyết phục những người mới tham gia.

senses.definition: the act or process of finding new people to join a company, an organization, the armed forces, etc.

examples.x: the recruitment of new members
a recruitment drive
a recruitment consultant/agency

senses.definition_vi: hành động hoặc quá trình tìm kiếm những người mới để tham gia một công ty, một tổ chức, lực lượng vũ trang, v.v.

senses.definition: to treat things that have already been used so that they can be used again

examples.x: to recycle waste/rubbish
Denmark recycles nearly 85% of its paper.
recycled materials
recycled plastic/glass/paper
Salt water is recycled using a special filter.
The bottles were being recycled into a lower-quality product.
He makes his own fuel from used grease recycled from local restaurants.

senses.definition_vi: xử lý những thứ đã được sử dụng để chúng có thể được sử dụng lại.

senses.definition: to use the same ideas, methods, jokes, etc. again

examples.x: He recycled all his old jokes.
They endlessly recycle the same worn-out arguments.

senses.definition_vi: sử dụng lại cùng những ý tưởng, phương pháp, câu chuyện cười, v.v.

senses.definition: having the colour of blood or fire

examples.x: bright/light/dark red lipstick
The lights (= traffic lights) changed to red before I could get across.
a bunch of red roses
a red dress/shirt
the vivid red colour of the soldiers' uniforms
Her essay was returned with lots of corrections in red ink.
a red car

senses.definition_vi: có màu của máu hoặc lửa.

senses.definition: red-brown in colour

examples.x: her flaming red hair
a red squirrel
a red-haired girl
Her hair was long and dark red.
She dyes her hair red.

senses.definition_vi: màu đỏ nâu.

senses.definition: bright red or pink, especially because you are angry, embarrassed or ashamed

examples.x: I felt my face go red.
She went red as a beetroot.
She went red as a beet.
He stammered something and went very red in the face.
He turned red and started yelling at me.
Her face was red with anger.
My face probably looked as red as a strawberry.

senses.definition_vi: đỏ tươi hoặc hồng, đặc biệt là vì bạn đang tức giận, bối rối hoặc xấu hổ.

senses.definition: bloodshot (= with thin lines of blood in them) or surrounded by red or very pink skin

examples.x: Her eyes were red from crying.
Her eyes were red and puffy, as if she'd been crying.

senses.definition_vi: bị đỏ (= với các đường máu mỏng trong đó) hoặc được bao quanh bởi da đỏ hoặc rất hồng.

senses.definition: (of an area in the US) having more people who vote for the Republican candidate than the Democratic one

examples.x: red states/counties

senses.definition_vi: (của một khu vực ở Hoa Kỳ) có nhiều người bỏ phiếu cho ứng cử viên Đảng Cộng hòa hơn Đảng Dân chủ.

senses.definition: having very left-wing political opinions; communist or socialist
senses.definition_vi: có quan điểm chính trị rất cánh tả; cộng sản hoặc xã hội chủ nghĩa.

senses.definition: to go to a lot of different bars, clubs, etc. and enjoy yourself
senses.definition_vi: đi đến rất nhiều quán bar, câu lạc bộ, v.v. khác nhau và vui chơi.

senses.definition: involving opposition or competition that is violent and without sympathy

examples.x: nature, red in tooth and claw

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến sự đối lập hoặc cạnh tranh tàn bạo và không khoan nhượng.

senses.definition: used to talk about something that is likely to make somebody very angry

examples.x: If you criticize him, it’s like a red rag to a bull—he gets absolutely furious.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để nói về điều gì đó có khả năng khiến ai đó rất tức giận

senses.definition: the colour of blood or fire

examples.x: She often wears red.
The woman blushed a deep shade of red.
the bright red of her blouse
the reds and browns of the woods in the fall (= of the leaves)
I've marked the corrections in red (= in red ink).
The traffic lights were on red.

senses.definition_vi: màu của máu hoặc lửa

senses.definition: red wine

examples.x: Would you prefer red or white?
an Italian red

senses.definition_vi: rượu vang đỏ

senses.definition: an offensive word for a communist or socialist
senses.definition_vi: một từ xúc phạm để chỉ một người cộng sản hoặc người theo chủ nghĩa xã hội

senses.definition: to owe money to your bank because you have spent more than you have in your account

examples.x: The company has plunged $37 million into the red.
My account is $100 in the red.

senses.definition_vi: nợ tiền ngân hàng của bạn vì bạn đã chi tiêu nhiều hơn số dư trong tài khoản của mình

senses.definition: to become very angry

examples.x: People who drop litter make me see red.

senses.definition_vi: trở nên rất tức giận

senses.definition: to make something less or smaller in size, quantity, price, etc.; to become less or smaller in size, quantity, etc.

examples.x: Reduce speed now (= on a sign).
Giving up smoking reduces the risk of heart disease.
to reduce costs/numbers
a reduced rate/price
They will require car makers to reduce emissions of carbon dioxide by 30%.
Costs have been reduced by 20% over the past year.

examples.cf: reduce something from something to something
examples.x: The number of employees was reduced from 40 to 25.
The skirt was reduced to £10 in the sale.
Towards the coast, the hills gradually reduce in size.
The number of search engines has reduced substantially over the last few years.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho cái gì đó ít hơn hoặc nhỏ hơn về kích thước, số lượng, giá cả, v.v.; trở nên ít hơn hoặc nhỏ hơn về kích thước, số lượng, v.v.

senses.definition: if you reduce a liquid or a liquid reduces, you boil it so that it becomes less in quantity
senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn cô đặc một chất lỏng hoặc một chất lỏng bị cô đặc, bạn đun sôi nó để giảm lượng chất lỏng

senses.definition: to lose weight by limiting the amount and type of food that you eat

examples.x: a reducing plan

senses.definition_vi: giảm cân bằng cách hạn chế lượng và loại thực phẩm bạn ăn

senses.definition: to add one or more electrons to a substance or to remove oxygen from a substance
senses.definition_vi: thêm một hoặc nhiều electron vào một chất hoặc loại bỏ oxy khỏi một chất

senses.definition: the state of being poorer than you were before. People say ‘living in reduced circumstances’ to avoid saying ‘poor’.
senses.definition_vi: tình trạng nghèo hơn trước đây. Người ta nói 'sống trong hoàn cảnh khó khăn' để tránh nói 'nghèo khổ'.

senses.definition: an act of making something less or smaller; the state of being made less or smaller

examples.x: Some staff received wage rises, while others experienced a reduction.
This year has seen a 33% reduction in the number of hospital beds available.
a drastic reduction in costs
Business is improving following the reduction in interest rates.
There has been some reduction in unemployment.
a significant/substantial reduction in spending
The report recommends further reductions in air and noise emissions.
Concern over global warming has not led to a reduction in the use of oil and gas.
Greater access to medical care for older people will result in reductions in mortality.
There are continuing demands for a reduction of US troop levels in the country.

senses.definition_vi: hành động làm cho cái gì đó ít hơn hoặc nhỏ hơn; tình trạng bị làm cho ít hơn hoặc nhỏ hơn

senses.definition: an amount of money by which something is made cheaper

examples.x: price reductions
There are reductions for children sharing a room with two adults.
a sale with massive reductions on selected items

senses.definition_vi: một khoản tiền mà cái gì đó được bán rẻ hơn

senses.definition: a copy of a photograph, map, picture, etc. that is made smaller than the original one
senses.definition_vi: một bản sao của ảnh, bản đồ, tranh, v.v. được làm nhỏ hơn bản gốc

senses.definition: the fact of adding one or more electrons to a substance or of removing oxygen from a substance
senses.definition_vi: hành động thêm một hoặc nhiều electron vào một chất hoặc loại bỏ oxy khỏi một chất

senses.definition: a sauce made by boiling a liquid until it becomes thick

examples.x: a red wine reduction
a reduction of chicken stock, wine and cream

senses.definition_vi: một loại nước sốt được làm bằng cách đun sôi chất lỏng cho đến khi nó đặc lại

senses.definition: to send somebody/something to somebody/something for help, advice or a decision

examples.x: My doctor referred me to a specialist.
The company says it has referred the matter to its lawyers.
The case was referred to the Court of Appeal.
May I refer you to my letter of 14 May?
Patients should be referred to a specialist pain clinic.
If you are referred urgently by your GP, a specialist should see you within two weeks.
She was referred for evaluation and treatment.

senses.definition_vi: gửi ai đó/điều gì đó đến ai đó/điều gì đó để được giúp đỡ, tư vấn hoặc đưa ra quyết định

senses.definition: the official who controls the game in some sports

examples.x: He was sent off for arguing with the referee.

senses.definition_vi: quan chức điều khiển trận đấu trong một số môn thể thao

senses.definition: a person who gives information about your character and ability, usually in a letter, for example when you are applying for a job

examples.x: The principal often acts as a referee for his students.
His former employer agreed to act as a referee for him.

senses.definition_vi: người cung cấp thông tin về tính cách và khả năng của bạn, thường là bằng văn bản, ví dụ khi bạn nộp đơn xin việc

senses.definition: a person who is asked to settle an argument

examples.x: to act as a referee between the parties involved

senses.definition_vi: người được yêu cầu giải quyết một tranh chấp

senses.definition: a person who reads and checks the quality of an academic article before it is published

examples.x: All papers are sent out to external referees.

senses.definition_vi: người đọc và kiểm tra chất lượng của một bài báo học thuật trước khi xuất bản

senses.definition: a thing you say or write that mentions somebody/something else; the act of mentioning somebody/something

examples.x: She made no reference to her illness but only to her future plans.
the President’s passing reference to (= brief mention of) the end of the war
Her book contains many biblical references.
His testimony included references to memos by the company's financial managers.
Study their correspondence and you find only three references to George Washington.
She discreetly avoided any specific reference to religion.
The book is full of references to growing up in India.
There are frequent references in the text to the English Civil War.

senses.definition_vi: một điều bạn nói hoặc viết đề cập đến ai đó/điều gì đó khác; hành động đề cập đến ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: the act of looking at something for information

examples.x: A copy of the booklet is given to the employee for reference.
Keep the list of numbers near the phone for easy reference.
I wrote down the name of the hotel for future reference (= because it might be useful in the future).
The library contains many popular works of reference (= books that contain facts and information).
We provided reference materials about our Greek vase collection.
Reference to the guide shows that the word has been used in the latter sense.

senses.definition_vi: hành động xem xét một cái gì đó để lấy thông tin

senses.definition: a number, word or symbol that shows where something is on a map, or where you can find a piece of information

examples.x: The map reference is Y4.
It is essential that an accurate grid reference is given.
Please quote your reference number when making an enquiry.

senses.definition_vi: một con số, từ hoặc ký hiệu cho biết vị trí của một cái gì đó trên bản đồ, hoặc nơi bạn có thể tìm thấy một thông tin

senses.definition: the act of asking somebody for help or advice

examples.x: The emergency nurse can treat minor injuries without reference to a doctor.
The decision was made without reference to local managers.

senses.definition_vi: hành động yêu cầu ai đó giúp đỡ hoặc tư vấn

senses.definition: a letter written by somebody who knows you, giving information about your character and abilities, especially to a new employer

examples.x: I'm sure she'll give you a good reference.
We will take up references (= contact the people who provided them) after the interview.
We'll need a reference from your current employer.
She asked him to provide a reference for her.

senses.definition_vi: một lá thư do ai đó biết bạn viết, cung cấp thông tin về tính cách và khả năng của bạn, đặc biệt là cho một nhà tuyển dụng mới

senses.definition: a person who agrees to write a reference, for you, for example when you are applying for a job

examples.x: My previous boss will act as a reference for me.
His former employer agreed to act as a reference for him.

senses.definition_vi: người đồng ý viết thư giới thiệu cho bạn, ví dụ khi bạn nộp đơn xin việc

senses.definition: a note in a book that tells you where a particular piece of information comes from

examples.x: There is a list of references at the end of each chapter.
For references, see Section D above.
References to previous research are listed in an appendix.

senses.definition_vi: một ghi chú trong sách cho biết nguồn gốc của một thông tin cụ thể

senses.definition: used to say what you are talking or writing about

examples.x: With reference to your letter of July 22…
I am writing with reference to your job application.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói bạn đang nói về hoặc viết về điều gì

senses.definition: an occasion when all the people of a country can vote on an important issue

examples.x: Switzerland decided to hold a referendum on joining the EU.
The changes were approved by referendum.

senses.definition_vi: một dịp mà tất cả người dân của một quốc gia có thể bỏ phiếu về một vấn đề quan trọng

senses.definition: to show the image of somebody/something on the surface of something such as a mirror, water or glass

examples.x: His face was reflected in the mirror.
She looked into the water and saw her face reflected there.
She could see herself reflected in his eyes.

senses.definition_vi: hiển thị hình ảnh của ai đó/điều gì đó trên bề mặt của vật gì đó như gương, nước hoặc kính

senses.definition: to throw back light, heat, sound, etc. from a surface

examples.x: The windows reflected the bright afternoon sunlight.
This material absorbs the sound, and doesn’t reflect it.
When the sun's rays hit the earth, a lot of the heat is reflected back into space.
The sun reflected dully off the stone walls.

senses.definition_vi: phản lại ánh sáng, nhiệt, âm thanh, v.v. từ một bề mặt

senses.definition: to show or be a sign of the nature of something or of somebody’s attitude or feeling

examples.x: Our newspaper aims to reflect the views of the local community.
His music reflects his interest in African culture.
This year's figures simply reflect the fact that we have fewer people out of work.
Does popular culture reflect reality or distort it?
They are constantly revising the dictionary to reflect changes in language.
Her remarks accurately reflect the views of most of us.

senses.definition_vi: thể hiện hoặc là dấu hiệu của bản chất của một cái gì đó hoặc thái độ hoặc cảm xúc của ai đó

senses.definition: to think carefully and deeply about something

examples.x: Before I decide, I need time to reflect.
She was left to reflect on the implications of her decision.
William had little time to reflect upon these episodes.
On the way home he reflected that the interview had gone well.
She reflected how different it could have been.
‘It could all have been so different,’ she reflected.

senses.definition_vi: suy nghĩ cẩn thận và sâu sắc về một điều gì đó

senses.definition: to make somebody/something appear to be good, bad, etc. to other people

examples.x: This incident reflects badly on everyone involved.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ai đó/điều gì đó có vẻ tốt, xấu, v.v. đối với người khác

senses.definition: an image in a mirror, on a shiny surface, on water, etc.

examples.x: He admired his reflection in the mirror.

senses.definition_vi: hình ảnh trong gương, trên bề mặt sáng bóng, trên mặt nước, v.v.

senses.definition: the action or process of sending back light, heat, sound, etc. from a surface

examples.x: There is reflection of heat from the metal surface.

senses.definition_vi: hành động hoặc quá trình phản lại ánh sáng, nhiệt, âm thanh, v.v. từ một bề mặt

senses.definition: a sign that shows the state or nature of something

examples.x: Your clothes are often a reflection of your personality.
This account is only a pale reflection of the true state of affairs.
The increase in crime is a sad reflection on (= shows something bad about) our society today.

senses.definition_vi: dấu hiệu cho thấy trạng thái hoặc bản chất của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: careful thought about something, sometimes over a long period of time

examples.x: A week off would give him time for reflection.
She decided on reflection to accept his offer after all.
It may be that, on mature reflection, you decide to cancel the plan.

senses.definition_vi: suy nghĩ cẩn thận về một điều gì đó, đôi khi trong một thời gian dài

senses.definition: your written or spoken thoughts about a particular subject or topic

examples.x: a book of her reflections on childhood

senses.definition_vi: suy nghĩ bằng văn bản hoặc lời nói của bạn về một chủ đề hoặc đề tài cụ thể

senses.definition: an account or a description of something

examples.x: The article is an accurate reflection of events that day.

senses.definition_vi: một bài tường thuật hoặc mô tả về điều gì đó

senses.definition: change that is made to a social system, an organization, etc. in order to improve or correct it

examples.x: a government committed to reform
economic/electoral/constitutional, etc. reform
the reform of the educational system
reforms in education
far-reaching/major/sweeping reforms

senses.definition_vi: sự thay đổi được thực hiện đối với một hệ thống xã hội, một tổ chức, v.v. để cải thiện hoặc sửa chữa nó

senses.definition: to improve a system, an organization, a law, etc. by making changes to it

examples.x: proposals to reform the social security system
The law needs to be reformed.
a reforming administration

senses.definition_vi: cải thiện một hệ thống, một tổ chức, một luật, v.v. bằng cách thực hiện các thay đổi đối với nó

senses.definition: to improve your behaviour; to make somebody do this

examples.x: He has promised to reform.
She thought she could reform him.

senses.definition_vi: cải thiện hành vi của bạn; làm cho ai đó làm điều này

senses.definition: shelter or protection from danger, trouble, etc.

examples.x: A further 300 people have taken refuge in the US embassy.
The region was a place of refuge for outlaws and bandits.
They were forced to seek refuge from the fighting.
As the situation at home got worse she increasingly took refuge in her work.

senses.definition_vi: sự che chở hoặc bảo vệ khỏi nguy hiểm, rắc rối, v.v.

senses.definition: a place, person or thing that provides shelter or protection for somebody/something

examples.x: The marshes are a wetland refuge for seabirds, waders and wild fowl.
He regarded the room as a refuge from the outside world.

senses.definition_vi: một nơi, người hoặc vật cung cấp nơi trú ẩn hoặc sự bảo vệ cho ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: a building that provides a temporary home for people in need of shelter or protection from somebody/something

examples.x: The best option for a female victim of domestic abuse is to contact a women's refuge.
During the great fire of 1871 the church served as a refuge for people who were homeless.

senses.definition_vi: một tòa nhà cung cấp nhà ở tạm thời cho những người cần nơi trú ẩn hoặc sự bảo vệ khỏi ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: an area in the middle of a road where you can stand and wait for cars to go past until it is safe for you to cross
senses.definition_vi: một khu vực ở giữa đường nơi bạn có thể đứng và đợi xe cộ đi qua cho đến khi an toàn để bạn băng qua

senses.definition: a person who has been forced to leave their country or home, because there is a war or for political, religious or social reasons

examples.x: There has been a steady flow of refugees from the war zone.
political/economic refugees
political refugees
a refugee camp

senses.definition_vi: một người đã buộc phải rời khỏi đất nước hoặc nhà của mình, vì có chiến tranh hoặc vì lý do chính trị, tôn giáo hoặc xã hội

senses.definition: an act of saying or showing that you will not do, give or accept something

examples.x: the refusal of a request/an invitation/an offer
a blunt/flat/curt refusal
His refusal to discuss the matter is very annoying.

senses.definition_vi: hành động nói hoặc thể hiện rằng bạn sẽ không làm, cho hoặc chấp nhận điều gì đó

senses.definition: to say or show that you will not do something that somebody has asked you to do

examples.x: Go on, ask her; she can hardly refuse.
He flatly refused to discuss the matter.
She refused to accept that there was a problem.
My brother refused to allow anyone to help him.
She refused to comment further.
He has steadfastly refused to answer my questions.
They simply refuse to give up.
The demand for an apology was pointedly refused.

senses.definition_vi: nói hoặc thể hiện rằng bạn sẽ không làm điều gì đó mà ai đó đã yêu cầu bạn làm

senses.definition: to say that you do not want something that has been offered to you

examples.x: I politely refused their invitation.
The job offer was simply too good to refuse.
I must refuse your generous offer.
She offered them cups of tea and it seemed churlish to refuse.

senses.definition_vi: nói rằng bạn không muốn điều gì đó đã được đề nghị cho bạn

senses.definition: to say that you will not allow something; to say that you will not give or allow somebody something that they want or need

examples.x: He refused our request for an interview.
The bank refused his demand for a full refund.
The authorities refused permission for the new housing development.
The judge refused her application for bail.
The government has refused all demands for a public inquiry.
They refused him a visa.
The judge refused them permission to appeal.
She would never refuse her kids anything.

senses.definition_vi: nói rằng bạn sẽ không cho phép điều gì đó; nói rằng bạn sẽ không cho hoặc cho phép ai đó thứ gì đó mà họ muốn hoặc cần

senses.definition: to fail to do what you want or expect it to do

examples.x: The car refused to start.
The problem simply refuses to go away.
My ear infection is refusing to heal.

senses.definition_vi: không làm những gì bạn muốn hoặc mong đợi nó làm

senses.definition: to get back something you no longer have, especially an ability or a quality

examples.x: I struggled to regain some dignity.
The party has regained control of the region.
She paused on the edge, trying to regain her balance.
She soon regained her composure.
He did not regain consciousness (= wake up after being unconscious) for several days.

senses.definition_vi: lấy lại thứ gì đó mà bạn không còn nữa, đặc biệt là một khả năng hoặc phẩm chất

senses.definition: to get back to a place that you have left

examples.x: They finally managed to regain the beach.

senses.definition_vi: quay trở lại một nơi bạn đã rời đi

senses.definition: attention to or thought and care for somebody/something

examples.x: to have scant/little/no regard for somebody/something
to pay/show little regard for other people’s property
Social services should pay proper regard to the needs of inner-city areas.
He was driving without regard to speed limits.

senses.definition_vi: sự chú ý hoặc suy nghĩ và sự quan tâm đến ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: respect for somebody/something

examples.x: He held her in high regard (= had a good opinion of her).
I had great regard for his abilities.
Children no longer have proper regard for their parents and teachers.

senses.definition_vi: sự tôn trọng đối với ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: used to send good wishes to somebody at the end of an email or letter, or when asking somebody to give your good wishes to another person who is not present

examples.x: With best/kind regards, Yours…
Give your brother my regards when you see him.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để gửi những lời chúc tốt đẹp đến ai đó vào cuối email hoặc thư, hoặc khi yêu cầu ai đó gửi lời chúc tốt đẹp của bạn đến một người khác không có mặt

senses.definition: to remember and think carefully about something

examples.x: It is always necessary to have regard to the terms of the contract.
New sites for waste disposal will be determined having regard to environmental matters.
When exercising its discretion, the court will have regard to all the circumstances.

senses.definition_vi: nhớ và suy nghĩ cẩn thận về điều gì đó

senses.definition: relating to somebody/something

examples.x: a country’s laws in regard to human rights
The company's position with regard to overtime is made clear in their contracts.
I am writing with regard to your recent order.

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: relating to what has just been mentioned

examples.x: I have nothing further to say in this regard.

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến những gì vừa được đề cập

senses.definition: to think about somebody/something in a particular way

examples.x: They regarded people outside their own town with suspicion.
Her work is very highly regarded.
He regards himself as a patriot.
Capital punishment was regarded as inhuman and immoral.
She is widely regarded as the current leader's natural successor.

senses.definition_vi: suy nghĩ về ai đó/điều gì đó theo một cách cụ thể

senses.definition: to look at somebody/something, especially in a particular way

examples.x: He regarded us suspiciously.

senses.definition_vi: nhìn ai đó/điều gì đó, đặc biệt là theo một cách cụ thể

senses.definition: relating to or in connection with somebody/something

examples.x: I have little information as regards her fitness for the post.
As regards the first point in your letter…

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến hoặc liên quan đến ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: paying no attention, even if the situation is bad or there are difficulties

examples.x: The weather was terrible but we carried on regardless.

senses.definition_vi: không chú ý, ngay cả khi tình hình tồi tệ hoặc có khó khăn

senses.definition: a method or system of government, especially one that has not been elected in a fair way

examples.x: a fascist/totalitarian/military, etc. regime
an oppressive/brutal regime

senses.definition_vi: một phương pháp hoặc hệ thống chính quyền, đặc biệt là một phương pháp không được bầu một cách công bằng

senses.definition: a method or system of organizing or managing something

examples.x: Our tax regime is one of the most favourable in Europe.

senses.definition_vi: một phương pháp hoặc hệ thống tổ chức hoặc quản lý một cái gì đó

senses.definition: a set of rules about food and exercise or medical treatment that you follow in order to stay healthy or to improve your health

examples.x: a dietary regime

senses.definition_vi: một bộ quy tắc về thực phẩm và tập thể dục hoặc điều trị y tế mà bạn tuân theo để giữ gìn sức khỏe hoặc cải thiện sức khỏe của mình

senses.definition: a large area of land, usually without exact limits or borders

examples.x: mountainous/coastal regions
the northern/southern/central, etc. region
This is one of the most densely populated regions of North America.
There are more than two million people living in the region.
Many new species have been discovered in the Amazon region.
Businesses across the region are supporting the project.
The plant is found throughout the western region of the country.

senses.definition_vi: một khu vực đất rộng, thường không có giới hạn hoặc đường biên giới chính xác

senses.definition: one of the areas that a country is divided into, that has its own customs and/or its own government

examples.x: Bilbao is the largest city in the Basque region in northern Spain.
The country is divided into 17 autonomous regions.

senses.definition_vi: một trong những khu vực mà một quốc gia được chia thành, có phong tục riêng và/hoặc chính phủ riêng

senses.definition: all of a country except the capital city

examples.x: People in the regions should not have to travel to London to fly to the United States.

senses.definition_vi: tất cả các quốc gia trừ thủ đô

senses.definition: a part of the body, usually one that has a particular character or problem

examples.x: pains in the abdominal region

senses.definition_vi: một phần của cơ thể, thường là một phần có đặc điểm hoặc vấn đề cụ thể

senses.definition: used when you are giving a number, price, etc. to show that it is not exact

examples.x: He earns somewhere in the region of €50 000.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đưa ra một con số, giá cả, v.v. để cho thấy rằng nó không chính xác

senses.definition: of or relating to a region

examples.x: services available at a local and regional level
the conflict between regional and national interests
a regional assembly/council/government
a regional director/manager
national initiatives for regional development
a regional office/centre/agency

senses.definition_vi: thuộc về hoặc liên quan đến một khu vực

senses.definition: an official list or record of names, items, etc.; a book that contains such a list

examples.x: The bride and groom signed the register.
Could you sign the hotel register please, sir?
They keep a register of all those who have contributed to the fund.
to be on the register of electors
an entry in a register
Income information will also appear in the register.
The teacher took the register (= checked who was present at school).
Dr Shaw was struck off the medical register for misconduct.

senses.definition_vi: một danh sách hoặc hồ sơ chính thức về tên, các mục, v.v.; một cuốn sách chứa danh sách như vậy

senses.definition: the range, or part of a range, of a human voice or a musical instrument

examples.x: in the upper/middle/lower register

senses.definition_vi: phạm vi, hoặc một phần của phạm vi, giọng nói con người hoặc nhạc cụ

senses.definition: the level and style of a piece of writing or speech, that is usually appropriate to the situation that it is used in

examples.x: The essay suddenly switches from a formal to an informal register.
He has adopted an informal register so as not to alienate his audience.

senses.definition_vi: mức độ và phong cách của một đoạn văn viết hoặc lời nói, thường phù hợp với tình huống mà nó được sử dụng

senses.definition: an opening, with a cover that you can have open or shut, that allows hot or cold air from a heating or cooling system into a room
senses.definition_vi: một lỗ thông hơi, có nắp đậy mà bạn có thể mở hoặc đóng, cho phép không khí nóng hoặc lạnh từ hệ thống sưởi hoặc làm mát vào phòng

senses.definition: a machine used in shops, restaurants, etc. for keeping money in, and that shows and records the amount of money received for each thing that is sold
senses.definition_vi: một máy được sử dụng trong các cửa hàng, nhà hàng, v.v. để giữ tiền, và hiển thị và ghi lại số tiền nhận được cho mỗi mặt hàng được bán

senses.definition: to record your/somebody’s/something’s name on an official list

examples.x: You can also register online.
to register a birth/marriage/death
to register a company/trademark
The site has 114 million registered users.
a registered charity
We expect about 50 per cent of registered voters to vote in the election.
The police has registered a case against the company.
The regulations require doctors and patients to register in a database.
The ship was registered in Panama.
Six other families were also registered at the same address.
to register at a hotel
She is officially registered disabled.
They encouraged all eligible citizens to register as voters.
He then registered the name as a trademark.
to register with a doctor/dentist
All childminders should be registered with the local authority.
About 700 people registered for the conference.
The drug has not been registered for use in Australia.
More than 5 000 people registered to take part in the contest.
78 per cent reported that they were registered to vote.

senses.definition_vi: ghi tên của bạn/ai đó/cái gì đó vào một danh sách chính thức

senses.definition: to make your opinion known officially or publicly

examples.x: Many saw the vote as a way to register a protest.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho ý kiến của bạn được biết đến một cách chính thức hoặc công khai

senses.definition: if a measuring instrument registers an amount or something registers an amount on a measuring instrument, the instrument shows or records that amount

examples.x: The thermometer registered 32°C.
The earthquake registered 3 on the Richter scale.
The stock exchange has registered huge losses this week.

senses.definition_vi: nếu một thiết bị đo hiển thị một lượng hoặc một cái gì đó hiển thị một lượng trên thiết bị đo, thì thiết bị đó cho thấy hoặc ghi lại lượng đó

senses.definition: to show or express a feeling

examples.x: Her face registered disapproval.
Shock registered on everyone's face.

senses.definition_vi: cho thấy hoặc bày tỏ một cảm xúc

senses.definition: to notice something and remember it; to be noticed

examples.x: He barely registered our presence.
I told her my name, but it obviously didn't register.
He vaguely registered that the women had gone.
Slowly, my mind began to register where I was: in the hospital.

senses.definition_vi: nhận thấy điều gì đó và ghi nhớ nó; được nhận thấy

senses.definition: to send something by mail, paying extra money to protect it against loss or damage

examples.x: Can I register this, please?
a registered letter

senses.definition_vi: gửi một cái gì đó qua thư, trả thêm tiền để bảo vệ nó khỏi bị mất hoặc hư hỏng

senses.definition: the act of making an official record of something/somebody

examples.x: the registration of letters and parcels
the registration of students for a course
registration fees
the registration of a child’s birth

senses.definition_vi: hành động lập một hồ sơ chính thức về điều gì đó/ai đó

senses.definition: a document showing that an official record has been made of something

examples.x: my Democratic party registration
the information on the registration roll
I traced my family history using the civil registration records.

senses.definition_vi: một tài liệu cho thấy một hồ sơ chính thức đã được lập về điều gì đó

senses.definition: the series of letters and numbers that are shown on a number plate at the front and back of a vehicle to identify it

examples.x: The police are looking for a black car with German registration plates.

senses.definition_vi: chuỗi chữ cái và số được hiển thị trên biển số xe ở phía trước và phía sau của một phương tiện để nhận dạng nó

senses.definition: the time when a teacher looks at the list of students on the class register and checks that the students are present
senses.definition_vi: thời điểm giáo viên xem danh sách học sinh trong sổ điểm danh và kiểm tra xem học sinh có mặt hay không

senses.definition: a sad feeling because of something that has happened or something that you have done or not done

examples.x: a feeling/pang/twinge of regret
It is a matter of regret that no proper investigation was carried out at the time.
What is your greatest regret (= the thing that you are most sorry about doing or not doing)?
It is with great regret that I accept your resignation.
She expressed her regret at the decision.
She admitted her regrets at having had to give up her youthful ambitions.
I have no regrets about leaving Newcastle (= I do not feel sorry about it).
He confessed to a few regrets about his time in Parliament.
There has still been no official expression of regret for their deaths.
He said he felt deep regret for having been part of a government that had brutally violated human rights.
He gave up teaching in 2009, much to the regret of his students.

senses.definition_vi: một cảm giác buồn bã vì điều gì đó đã xảy ra hoặc điều gì đó bạn đã làm hoặc chưa làm

senses.definition: to feel sorry about something you have done or about something that you have not been able to do

examples.x: If you don't do it now, you'll only regret it.
The decision could be one he lives to regret.
I soon came to regret my action.
‘I've had a wonderful life,’ she said, ‘I don't regret a thing.’
She regretted the words the moment they were out of her mouth.
He bitterly regretted ever having mentioned it.
I never regretted dropping out of college.
I deeply regret what I said.
I regret that I never got to meet him in person.

senses.definition_vi: cảm thấy tiếc về điều gì đó bạn đã làm hoặc về điều gì đó bạn đã không thể làm

senses.definition: used to say in a polite or formal way that you are sorry or sad about a situation

examples.x: The airline regrets any inconvenience.
The president said that his country deeply regretted the incident.
The United States regrets the loss of innocent civilian lives.
I regret that I am unable to accept your kind invitation.
I very much regret that I cannot be with you this evening.
We regret to inform you that your application has not been successful.
I regret to say that we cannot let you have the picture.
It is to be regretted that so many young people leave school without qualifications.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói một cách lịch sự hoặc trang trọng rằng bạn xin lỗi hoặc buồn về một tình huống

senses.definition: following a pattern, especially with the same time or space in between each thing and the next

examples.x: regular breathing
a regular pulse/heartbeat
A light flashed at regular intervals.
There is a regular bus service to the airport.
regular meetings/visits
We also hold a regular monthly meeting.
The equipment is checked on a regular basis.
She writes a regular column for a national newspaper.
a regular geometric pattern

senses.definition_vi: theo một khuôn mẫu, đặc biệt là với cùng một khoảng thời gian hoặc không gian giữa mỗi thứ và thứ tiếp theo

senses.definition: done or happening often

examples.x: Do you take regular exercise?
I'm still in regular contact with friends I met at university.
Domestic violence is a regular occurrence in some families.
a painter whose work is a regular feature of the Summer Exhibition
The key to good anti-virus software is regular updates.

senses.definition_vi: được thực hiện hoặc xảy ra thường xuyên

senses.definition: doing the same thing or going to the same place often

examples.x: regular readers/customers/users
She is a regular contributor to many journals and magazines
regular offenders (= against the law)
He was a regular visitor to her house.

senses.definition_vi: thực hiện cùng một việc hoặc đến cùng một nơi thường xuyên

senses.definition: changing their form in the same way as most other verbs and nouns

examples.x: The past participle of regular verbs ends in ‘-ed’.

senses.definition_vi: thay đổi hình thức của chúng theo cách tương tự như hầu hết các động từ và danh từ khác

senses.definition: usual

examples.x: I couldn't see my regular doctor today.
On Monday he would have to return to his regular duties.
It's important to follow the regular procedure.
He was mistaken for one of the regular crew.
the last match of the regular season

senses.definition_vi: thông thường; bình thường

senses.definition: of a standard size

examples.x: Regular or large fries?

senses.definition_vi: có kích thước tiêu chuẩn

senses.definition: ordinary; without any special or extra features

examples.x: Do you want regular or diet cola?
I just want to buy a regular white shirt—nothing fancy.
He's just a regular guy who loves his dog.

senses.definition_vi: tầm thường; không có bất kỳ đặc điểm đặc biệt hoặc bổ sung nào

senses.definition: having an even shape

examples.x: a face with regular features
He flashed a smile, showing two rows of white, regular teeth.
Her face was perfectly regular.

senses.definition_vi: có hình dạng đều đặn

senses.definition: lasting or happening over a long period

examples.x: The need to earn a regular income restricted the time he could spend pursuing his real interests.
She couldn't find any regular employment.

senses.definition_vi: kéo dài hoặc xảy ra trong một thời gian dài

senses.definition: belonging to or connected with the permanent armed forces or police force of a country

examples.x: the regular army
regular soldiers

senses.definition_vi: thuộc về hoặc liên quan đến lực lượng vũ trang thường trực hoặc lực lượng cảnh sát của một quốc gia

senses.definition: used for emphasis to show that somebody/something is an exact or clear example of the thing mentioned

examples.x: The whole thing was a regular disaster.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nhấn mạnh để cho thấy ai đó/cái gì đó là một ví dụ chính xác hoặc rõ ràng về thứ được đề cập

senses.definition: very regularly; happening at the same time in the same way

examples.x: He is home by six every day, regular as clockwork.

senses.definition_vi: rất thường xuyên; xảy ra vào cùng một thời điểm theo cùng một cách

senses.definition: at regular intervals or times

examples.x: We meet regularly to discuss the progress of the project.
the introduction of direct, regularly scheduled flights to Beijing
The water in the fish tank should be changed regularly.

senses.definition_vi: vào những khoảng thời gian hoặc thời điểm đều đặn

senses.definition: often

examples.x: I go there quite regularly.
He admitted that he regularly used drugs.
The couple regularly attended Mass.
As Home Secretary he had regularly visited Belfast.
She appeared regularly at the Metropolitan Opera.

senses.definition_vi: thường xuyên

senses.definition: in an even or balanced way

examples.x: The plants were spaced regularly, about 50 cm apart.

senses.definition_vi: một cách đều đặn hoặc cân bằng

senses.definition: to control something by means of rules

examples.x: The department is responsible for regulating the insurance industry.
The activities of credit companies are regulated by law.
The government accepts whaling in principle as long as it is carefully regulated.
It is up to the regulating authority to put the measures into effect.

senses.definition_vi: kiểm soát một cái gì đó bằng các quy tắc

senses.definition: to control the speed, pressure, temperature, etc. in a machine or system

examples.x: This valve regulates the flow of water.

senses.definition_vi: kiểm soát tốc độ, áp suất, nhiệt độ, v.v. trong một máy móc hoặc hệ thống

senses.definition: an official rule made by a government or some other authority

examples.x: too many rules and regulations
fire/building regulations
the strict regulations governing the sale of weapons
To comply with government hygiene regulations, there must be a separate sink for hand washing.
It's against safety regulations to fix these doors open.
Under the new regulations spending on office equipment will be strictly controlled.

senses.definition_vi: một quy tắc chính thức do chính phủ hoặc cơ quan có thẩm quyền khác ban hành

senses.definition: controlling something by means of rules

examples.x: the voluntary regulation of the press

senses.definition_vi: kiểm soát một cái gì đó bằng các quy tắc

senses.definition: a person or an organization that officially controls an area of business or industry and makes sure that it is operating fairly

examples.x: Ofgas, the gas industry regulator
banking regulators

senses.definition_vi: một người hoặc một tổ chức chính thức kiểm soát một lĩnh vực kinh doanh hoặc công nghiệp và đảm bảo rằng nó đang hoạt động công bằng

senses.definition: a device that controls something such as speed, temperature or pressure

examples.x: a pressure regulator

senses.definition_vi: một thiết bị kiểm soát một cái gì đó như tốc độ, nhiệt độ hoặc áp suất

senses.definition: having the power to control an area of business or industry and make sure that it is operating fairly

examples.x: regulatory bodies/authorities/agencies
regulatory procedures

senses.definition_vi: có quyền kiểm soát một lĩnh vực kinh doanh hoặc công nghiệp và đảm bảo rằng nó đang hoạt động công bằng

senses.definition: the process of helping somebody to return to a normal, healthy life after they have been in prison or very ill

examples.x: a drug rehabilitation centre
the rehabilitation of offenders

senses.definition_vi: quá trình giúp ai đó trở lại cuộc sống bình thường, khỏe mạnh sau khi họ đã ở trong tù hoặc bị bệnh nặng

senses.definition: the act of starting to consider that somebody is good or acceptable after a long period during which they were considered bad or unacceptable

examples.x: the rehabilitation of Magritte as an artist

senses.definition_vi: hành động bắt đầu coi ai đó là tốt hoặc được chấp nhận sau một thời gian dài mà họ bị coi là xấu hoặc không thể chấp nhận

senses.definition: the process of returning a building, place or area of activity to its previous good condition

examples.x: the rehabilitation of the steel industry

senses.definition_vi: quá trình trả lại một tòa nhà, địa điểm hoặc lĩnh vực hoạt động về tình trạng tốt trước đây của nó

senses.definition: the period during which a king, queen, emperor, etc. rules

examples.x: By the end of his reign, the vast empire was in decline.
The house was built during the reign of Henry VIII.

senses.definition_vi: khoảng thời gian mà một vị vua, nữ hoàng, hoàng đế, v.v. cai trị

senses.definition: the period during which somebody is in charge of an organization, a team, etc.

examples.x: Sir Alex Ferguson's reign at Manchester United
The story only came out during the final days of his reign as Chief Executive.

senses.definition_vi: khoảng thời gian mà ai đó phụ trách một tổ chức, một đội, v.v.

senses.definition: to rule as king, queen, emperor, etc.

examples.x: It was the first visit by a British reigning monarch to Russia.
Queen Victoria reigned from 1837 to 1901.
Herod reigned over Palestine at that time.

senses.definition_vi: cai trị với tư cách là vua, nữ hoàng, hoàng đế, v.v.

senses.definition: to be the best or most important in a particular situation or area of skill

examples.x: She will face the reigning champion in her first round match.
In the field of classical music, he still reigns supreme.

senses.definition_vi: là người giỏi nhất hoặc quan trọng nhất trong một tình huống hoặc lĩnh vực kỹ năng cụ thể

senses.definition: to be the most obvious feature of a place or moment

examples.x: At last silence reigned (= there was complete silence).
For a while, chaos and confusion reigned.

senses.definition_vi: là đặc điểm rõ ràng nhất của một địa điểm hoặc khoảnh khắc

senses.definition: to make a feeling, an idea, etc. stronger

examples.x: The experience reinforced my sense of loss.
Such jokes tend to reinforce gender stereotypes.
The climate of political confusion has only reinforced the country's economic decline.
Success in the talks will reinforce his reputation as an international statesman.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho một cảm giác, một ý tưởng, v.v. mạnh mẽ hơn

senses.definition: to make a structure or material stronger, especially by adding another material to it

examples.x: All buildings are now reinforced to withstand earthquakes.
reinforced plastic/steel/concrete
The door was built of oak, heavily reinforced with iron.

senses.definition_vi: làm cho một cấu trúc hoặc vật liệu chắc chắn hơn, đặc biệt bằng cách thêm một vật liệu khác vào nó

senses.definition: to send more people or equipment in order to make an army, etc. stronger

examples.x: The UN has undertaken to reinforce its military presence along the borders.

senses.definition_vi: gửi thêm người hoặc thiết bị để làm cho quân đội, v.v. mạnh hơn

senses.definition: to refuse to accept or consider something

examples.x: to reject an argument/a hypothesis/a notion/a plan
to reject a claim/an offer/a request/an application
The bank has the option of accepting or rejecting this offer.
The prime minister rejected any idea of reforming the system.
The proposal was firmly rejected.
School officials flatly rejected the proposal.
All our suggestions were rejected out of hand.
The Government rejected calls for an inquiry.

senses.definition_vi: từ chối chấp nhận hoặc xem xét điều gì đó

senses.definition: to refuse to accept somebody for a job, position, etc.

examples.x: Please reject the following candidates…
I've been rejected by all the universities I applied to.
Some applicants were rejected outright.
We considered offering him the job, but finally rejected him.

senses.definition_vi: từ chối chấp nhận ai đó cho một công việc, vị trí, v.v.

senses.definition: to decide not to use, sell, publish, etc. something because its quality is not good enough

examples.x: Imperfect articles are rejected by our quality control.
The book was at first rejected by publishers.

senses.definition_vi: quyết định không sử dụng, bán, xuất bản, v.v. một cái gì đó vì chất lượng của nó không đủ tốt

senses.definition: to not accept a new organ after a transplant operation, by producing substances that attack the organ

examples.x: Her body has already rejected two kidneys.

senses.definition_vi: cơ thể không chấp nhận một cơ quan mới sau một ca phẫu thuật cấy ghép, bằng cách sản xuất các chất tấn công cơ quan đó

senses.definition: to fail to give a person or an animal enough love or care

examples.x: The lioness rejected the smallest cub, which died.
When her husband left home she felt rejected and useless.

senses.definition_vi: không dành cho một người hoặc động vật đủ tình yêu thương hoặc sự chăm sóc

senses.definition: the act of refusing to accept or consider something

examples.x: Her proposal met with unanimous rejection.

senses.definition_vi: hành động từ chối chấp nhận hoặc xem xét điều gì đó

senses.definition: the act of refusing to accept somebody for a job, position, etc.

examples.x: a rejection letter (= a letter in which you are told, for example, that you have not been accepted for a job)

senses.definition_vi: hành động từ chối chấp nhận ai đó cho một công việc, vị trí, v.v.

senses.definition: the decision not to use, sell, publish, etc. something because its quality is not good enough

examples.x: I've had letters of rejection from several publishers.
Everyone from George Orwell to JK Rowling has had rejection slips (= formal notice from a publisher that a book, etc. is rejected).

senses.definition_vi: quyết định không sử dụng, bán, xuất bản, v.v. một cái gì đó vì chất lượng của nó không đủ tốt

senses.definition: the failure of somebody's body to accept a new organ after a transplant operation

examples.x: He had a second lung transplant after rejection of the first.

senses.definition_vi: sự thất bại của cơ thể ai đó trong việc chấp nhận một cơ quan mới sau một ca phẫu thuật cấy ghép

senses.definition: failure to give a person or an animal enough love or care

examples.x: painful feelings of rejection

senses.definition_vi: thất bại trong việc dành cho một người hoặc động vật đủ tình yêu thương hoặc sự chăm sóc

senses.definition: show or make a connection between two or more things

examples.x: I found it difficult to relate the two ideas in my mind.
In the future, pay increases will be related to productivity.
Attempts to relate studies on animals to those on humans are not really comparing like with like.

senses.definition_vi: thể hiện hoặc tạo ra mối liên hệ giữa hai hoặc nhiều điều

senses.definition: to give a spoken or written report of something; to tell a story

examples.x: Then he related a story about his days working in a research laboratory.
She relates her childhood experiences in the first chapters.
He related the facts of the case to journalists.
She related how he had run away from home as a boy.
The story relates that an angel appeared and told him to sing.

senses.definition_vi: đưa ra một báo cáo bằng lời nói hoặc bằng văn bản về điều gì đó; kể một câu chuyện

senses.definition: connected with something/somebody in some way

examples.x: The amount of protein you need is directly related to your lifestyle.
Much of the crime in this area is related to drug abuse.
Parental unemployment was not significantly related to youth unemployment for the total sample.
These problems are closely related.
a related issue
a related question/subject/matter
links on the website to related articles
institutions engaged in similar or related activities
education and training and other related topics
In related news, the star was rushed to a Los Angeles hospital on Wednesday night.
He was suffering from a stress-related illness.
These two incidents are closely related to each other.

senses.definition_vi: có liên quan đến điều gì đó/ai đó theo một cách nào đó

senses.definition: in the same family

examples.x: We're distantly related.
Are you related to Margaret?
He claims to be distantly related to the British royal family.
The Logans and the Fishers were related by marriage.
We were closely related by blood.

senses.definition_vi: trong cùng một gia đình

senses.definition: belonging to the same group

examples.x: related species
related languages
The llama is related to the camel.
All the bees in the colony are genetically related.

senses.definition_vi: thuộc cùng một nhóm

senses.definition: the way in which two people, groups or countries behave towards each other or deal with each other

examples.x: diplomatic/international/foreign relations
US-Chinese relations
teacher-student relations
Relations with neighbouring countries are under strain at present.
We seek to improve relations between our two countries.
to have sexual relations (= to have sex)

senses.definition_vi: cách hai người, nhóm hoặc quốc gia cư xử với nhau hoặc đối xử với nhau

senses.definition: the way in which two or more things are connected

examples.x: the relation between rainfall and crop yields
the relation of the farmer to the land
The fee they are offering bears no relation to the amount of work involved.
Little of what he said has any relation to fact.
I have some comments to make in relation to (= about) this matter.
Its brain is small in relation to (= compared with) its body.

senses.definition_vi: cách hai hoặc nhiều điều có liên quan với nhau

senses.definition: a person who is in the same family as somebody else

examples.x: a close/near/distant relation of mine
a relation by marriage
a party for friends and relations
He's called Brady too, but we're no relation (= not related).
Is he any relation to you?
What relation is Rita to you?

senses.definition_vi: một người thuộc cùng một gia đình với ai đó

senses.definition: the way in which two people, groups or countries behave towards each other or deal with each other

examples.x: a personal/working relationship
a master-servant relationship
This is an opportunity to build positive customer relationships.
The relationship between the police and the local community has improved.
the bilateral relationship between the US and China
She has a very close relationship with her sister.
I have established a good working relationship with my boss.
We have a relationship of trust with our clients.

senses.definition_vi: cách hai người, nhóm hoặc quốc gia cư xử với nhau hoặc đối xử với nhau

senses.definition: a loving and/or sexual friendship between two people

examples.x: Their affair did not develop into a long-term relationship.
It was his first sexual relationship.
Money problems have put a strain on their relationship.
She was having a relationship with a younger man.
She got involved in a romantic relationship with a colleague.
The relationship between Joe and Carmen is at the heart of the film.
Are you in a relationship?
People in same-sex relationships want equal pension rights.

senses.definition_vi: một tình bạn lãng mạn và/hoặc tình dục giữa hai người

senses.definition: the way in which two or more things are connected

examples.x: The study demonstrated associations, but no causal relationship.
They examine the relationship between poverty and crime.
She explores the intimate relationship between creation and pain.
There is often an inverse relationship between the power of the tool and how easy it is to use.
There is a symbiotic relationship (= in which both depend on the other and both get benefits) between our urban centres and the countryside.
This comment bore no relationship to the subject of our conversation.
the complex relationship of culture to politics
They measured height in relationship to weight.
Job insecurity had a significant relationship with alcohol abuse.

senses.definition_vi: cách hai hoặc nhiều điều có liên quan với nhau

senses.definition: the way in which a person is related to somebody else in a family

examples.x: They have a very healthy father-son relationship.
I'm not sure of the exact relationship between them—I think they're cousins.
their relationship to each other
He claimed to have a distant relationship with royalty.

senses.definition_vi: cách một người có quan hệ với người khác trong gia đình

senses.definition: considered and judged by being compared with something else

examples.x: You must consider the relative merits of the two plans.

senses.definition_vi: được xem xét và đánh giá bằng cách so sánh với điều gì đó khác

senses.definition: referring to an earlier noun, sentence or part of a sentence

senses.definition_vi: đề cập đến một danh từ, câu hoặc một phần của câu trước đó

senses.definition_vi: so với ai đó/điều gì đó khác; liên quan đến ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: having a connection with somebody/something; concerning somebody/something

examples.x: He may have information relative to the case.

senses.definition_vi: có mối liên hệ với ai đó/điều gì đó; liên quan đến ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: a person who is in the same family as somebody else

senses.definition_vi: một người thuộc cùng một gia đình với ai đó

senses.definition_vi: một thứ thuộc cùng một nhóm với một thứ khác

senses.definition: to a fairly large degree, especially in comparison to something else

examples.x: relatively large/small/high/low

These students had a relatively simple task.

He was charged with a relatively minor offence.

senses.definition_vi: ở một mức độ khá lớn, đặc biệt là khi so sánh với điều gì đó khác

senses.definition: used when you are comparing something with all similar things

examples.x: Relatively speaking, these jobs provide good salaries.
The colleges had become, relatively speaking, short of funds.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đang so sánh một thứ gì đó với tất cả các thứ tương tự

senses.definition: to rest while you are doing something that you enjoy, especially after work or effort

examples.x: Just relax and enjoy the movie.
I'm going to spend the weekend just relaxing.
He was relaxing at home, watching TV.
She finished her lunch and then relaxed in the sun.
The boys had been relaxing on the beach at their resort.
You need a little time to relax and unwind.
When I get home from work I like to relax with the newspaper.
Sit back and relax with a cup of tea.

senses.definition_vi: nghỉ ngơi khi bạn đang làm điều gì đó mà bạn thích, đặc biệt là sau công việc hoặc nỗ lực

senses.definition: to become or make somebody become calmer and less worried

examples.x: I'll only relax when I know you're safe.
I can't relax until I've spoken to her myself.
'You need to try and relax,' Jane said.
Relax! Everything will be OK.
A herbal tea will relax you.

senses.definition_vi: trở nên hoặc làm cho ai đó trở nên bình tĩnh hơn và bớt lo lắng hơn

senses.definition: to become or make something become less tight or stiff

examples.x: Allow your muscles to relax completely.

He relaxed his grip on her arm.

The dictator refuses to relax his grip on power.

senses.definition_vi: trở nên hoặc làm cho một cái gì đó trở nên bớt căng hoặc cứng

examples.x: to relax rules/restrictions/regulations/requirements

senses.definition_vi: cho phép các quy tắc, luật lệ, v.v. trở nên bớt nghiêm ngặt hơn

senses.definition: to allow your attention or effort to become weaker

examples.x: You cannot afford to relax your concentration for a moment.

senses.definition_vi: cho phép sự chú ý hoặc nỗ lực của bạn trở nên yếu đi

senses.definition: calm and not anxious or worried

examples.x: He appeared relaxed and confident before the match.
She had a very relaxed manner.
She looked completely relaxed, as if she didn't have a worry in the world.

senses.definition_vi: bình tĩnh và không lo lắng hay bồn chồn

senses.definition: calm and informal

examples.x: a family-run hotel with a relaxed atmosphere
Candles and soft music create a relaxed environment.

senses.definition_vi: bình tĩnh và không câu nệ hình thức

senses.definition: not caring too much about discipline or making people follow rules

examples.x: I take a fairly relaxed attitude towards what the kids wear to school.

senses.definition_vi: không quá quan tâm đến kỷ luật hoặc việc bắt buộc mọi người tuân theo quy tắc

examples.x: a relaxing evening with friends
a relaxing weekend/afternoon/holiday
a relaxing bath/massage

senses.definition_vi: giúp bạn nghỉ ngơi và bớt lo lắng

senses.definition: the act of setting a person or an animal free; the state of being set free

Following his release from prison, he moved to London.
The release of female prisoners from government jails was part of the deal.

She can expect an early release from prison.

senses.definition_vi: hành động thả một người hoặc động vật được tự do; trạng thái được tự do

senses.definition: the act of making a film, recording or other product available to the public

examples.x: The new software is planned for release in April.

The film never received a theatrical release (= was not shown in cinemas).

It's still seven weeks till the film's official release.

senses.definition_vi: hành động làm cho thông tin có sẵn cho công chúng

senses.definition_vi: miễn cho ai đó khỏi một nhiệm vụ, trách nhiệm, hợp đồng, v.v.

examples.x: relevant information/facts/documents/factors

examples.cf: it is relevant to do something

senses.definition_vi: kết nối chặt chẽ với chủ đề bạn đang thảo luận hoặc tình huống bạn đang ở trong

senses.definition: the fact of being valuable and useful to people in their lives and work

examples.x: Her novel is still relevant today.

senses.definition_vi: việc có giá trị và hữu ích cho mọi người trong cuộc sống và công việc của họ

examples.x: My car's not as reliable as it used to be.

senses.definition_vi: tin tưởng mạnh mẽ vào một tôn giáo cụ thể và tuân theo các luật lệ và thực hành của nó

senses.definition_vi: không tham gia vào một cái gì đó; không thể hiện sự quan tâm đến mọi người

senses.definition_vi: những phần còn lại của một cái gì đó sau khi các phần khác đã được sử dụng, ăn, loại bỏ, v.v.

She agreed to rent the room to me.
She agreed to rent me the room.

senses.definition_vi: cho phép ai đó sử dụng một thứ gì đó thuộc sở hữu của bạn, chẳng hạn như nhà hoặc đất đai, để đổi lấy các khoản thanh toán thường xuyên

senses.definition: to pay money to somebody so that you can use something for a short period of time

examples.x: to rent a film/movie/DVD
We rented a car for the week and explored the area.
to rent a bike/van/boat
They rented a meeting room in a downtown hotel.

senses.definition_vi: trả tiền để sử dụng một thứ gì đó trong một khoảng thời gian ngắn

senses.definition: to be available for somebody to use if they pay a particular amount of money

examples.x: The apartment rents for $500 a month.

senses.definition_vi: sẵn sàng để ai đó sử dụng nếu họ trả một khoản tiền nhất định

senses.definition: the amount of money that you pay to use something for a particular period of time

examples.x: Telephone charges include line rental.

senses.definition_vi: số tiền bạn phải trả để sử dụng một thứ gì đó trong một khoảng thời gian nhất định

senses.definition: the act of renting something or an arrangement to rent something

examples.x: the world’s largest car rental company
a rental car
a minimum rental period of three months

senses.definition_vi: hành động cho thuê một thứ gì đó hoặc một thỏa thuận để thuê một thứ gì đó

senses.definition: a house, car or piece of equipment that you can rent

examples.x: ‘Is this your own car?’ ‘No, it's a rental.’

senses.definition_vi: một ngôi nhà, xe hơi hoặc thiết bị mà bạn có thể thuê

senses.definition: an act of repairing something

examples.x: They agreed to pay the costs of any repairs.
The building was in need of repair.
I took my bike in for repair.
The car was damaged beyond repair (= it was too badly damaged to be repaired).
The hotel is currently under repair (= being repaired).
The bridge will remain closed until essential repair work has been carried out.
a repair shop
