proteins that are involved in DNA repair
They agreed to pay for the repair of any damage done.
Vitamin A is essential for the growth and repair of skin tissue.
The money was to be used for repairs to the school.
He quickly carried out a temporary repair to the window.
The meeting will discuss repairs to the church roof.

senses.definition_vi: hành động sửa chữa một thứ gì đó

senses.definition: in good, etc. condition

examples.x: The house is not in good repair.

senses.definition_vi: trong tình trạng tốt, v.v.

senses.definition: to fix something that is broken, damaged or torn

examples.x: to repair a car/television
to repair a road/wall/building/bridge
to repair a hole/crack/leak
to repair an injury/a hernia/a tear/a defect
to repair a ligament/tendon/cartilage
He has had surgery to repair the damage.
His surgically repaired knee is bothering him.
It's almost 15 years old. It isn't worth having it repaired.
We need to get the roof repaired.
the budget for maintaining and repairing equipment
The human body has an amazing capacity to repair itself.

senses.definition_vi: sửa chữa một thứ gì đó bị hỏng, hư hại hoặc rách

senses.definition: to say or do something in order to improve a bad or unpleasant situation

examples.x: to repair relations/a relationship
It was too late to repair the damage done to their relationship.
The home team did well to repair a bad start.
They moved quickly to repair relations between themselves and the US.

senses.definition_vi: nói hoặc làm điều gì đó để cải thiện một tình huống tồi tệ hoặc khó chịu

senses.definition: an event that is very similar to something that happened before

examples.x: She didn't want a repeat performance of what had happened the night before.
A repeat of the 1906 earthquake could kill up to 11 000 people.
a repeat order (= for a further supply of the same goods)
a repeat prescription (= for more of the same medicine)
a repeat offender (= somebody who commits a crime again)
revenues generated from repeat business
Something needs to be done urgently to prevent a repeat of this incident.

senses.definition_vi: một sự kiện rất giống với điều đã xảy ra trước đó

senses.definition: a television or radio programme that has been broadcast before

examples.x: ‘Is it a new series?’ ‘No, a repeat.’

senses.definition_vi: một chương trình truyền hình hoặc radio đã được phát sóng trước đó

senses.definition: a passage that is repeated
senses.definition_vi: một đoạn được lặp lại

senses.definition: to say or write something again or more than once

examples.x: to repeat a question/a claim/an assertion/a warning
to repeat a phrase/mantra
She repeated the word several times.
I'm sorry—could you repeat that?
She kept repeating his name softly over and over again.
The opposition have been repeating their calls for the president's resignation.
Are you prepared to repeat these allegations in court?
I mentioned it before, but it bears (= is worth) repeating.
Do say if I'm repeating myself (= if I have already said this).
He's fond of repeating that the company's success is all down to him.
‘Are you really sure?’ she repeated.

senses.definition_vi: nói hoặc viết lại điều gì đó hoặc nhiều hơn một lần

senses.definition: used to emphasize something that you have already said

examples.x: The claims are, I repeat, totally unfounded.
Nor, to repeat, can these changes be avoided.
I am not, repeat not, travelling in the same car as him!

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nhấn mạnh một điều gì đó bạn đã nói

senses.definition: to say something that somebody else has said, especially in order to learn it

examples.x: The teacher's statement is then repeated by the students.
Listen and repeat each sentence after me.
Can you repeat what I've just said word for word?
‘We were both asleep and didn’t hear anything,’ she repeated.

senses.definition_vi: nói điều gì đó mà người khác đã nói, đặc biệt là để học nó

senses.definition: to tell somebody something that you have heard or been told by somebody else

examples.x: I don't want you to repeat a word of this to anyone.
The rumour has been widely repeated in the press.

senses.definition_vi: kể cho ai đó điều gì đó mà bạn đã nghe hoặc được ai đó khác nói

senses.definition: to do or produce something again or more than once

examples.x: to repeat a mistake/process
to repeat an experiment/exercise
Organizers are hoping to repeat the success of last year's event.
He won his first Monaco Grand Prix in 1994 and repeated the feat in 1995, 1997 and 1999.
The treatment should be repeated every two to three hours.
They are hoping to repeat last year's victory.
These offers are unlikely to be repeated.
The programmes will be repeated next year.
to repeat a class/year/grade (= in a school, to take a class/year/grade again)
Lift and lower the right leg 20 times. Repeat with the left leg.

senses.definition_vi: làm hoặc tạo ra một cái gì đó một lần nữa hoặc nhiều hơn một lần

senses.definition: to happen more than once in the same way

examples.x: History has a strange way of repeating itself.
This phrase is repeated at intervals throughout the song.
a repeating pattern/design
A single note repeated over and over again, throbbing in my head.

senses.definition_vi: xảy ra nhiều hơn một lần theo cùng một cách

senses.definition: if food repeats, you can taste it for some time after you have eaten it

examples.x: Do you find that onions repeat on you?

senses.definition_vi: nếu thức ăn bị lặp lại, bạn có thể nếm nó trong một thời gian sau khi ăn

senses.definition: happening, said or done many times

examples.x: repeated absences from work
She did not respond to repeated requests for interviews.
The marriage failed despite repeated attempts to save it.
Each year we issue repeated warnings of the dangers from fireworks.
He has faced repeated calls for his resignation.

senses.definition_vi: xảy ra, được nói hoặc được thực hiện nhiều lần

senses.definition: to be used instead of somebody/something else; to do something instead of somebody/something else

examples.x: The new design will eventually replace all existing models.
Teachers will never be replaced by computers in the classroom.
These measures in no way replace the need for regular safety checks.
The weird feeling was gradually replaced by shock, and then anger.
She replaced Dr Hales as head teacher.
Green will replace the injured Walker in the starting line-up.
He was selected last week to replace her on the council.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng thay cho người/thứ khác; làm điều gì đó thay cho người/thứ khác

senses.definition: to remove somebody/something and put another person or thing in their place

examples.x: He will be difficult to replace when he leaves.
proposed changes to the constitution to replace the current system of government
He was replaced as party leader in 1967.
It is not a good idea to miss meals and replace them with snacks.

senses.definition_vi: loại bỏ ai đó/thứ gì đó và đặt một người hoặc thứ khác vào vị trí của họ

senses.definition: to change something that is old, damaged, etc. for a similar thing that is newer or better

examples.x: We're thinking of replacing our phone system.
to replace a window/roof
to replace a battery/light bulb
All the old carpets need replacing.
an operation to replace both hips
You'll be expected to replace any broken glasses.
The club does not have the finances resources to replace the damaged equipment.
We will replace a faulty part immediately.

senses.definition_vi: thay đổi một thứ gì đó cũ, bị hỏng, v.v. bằng một thứ tương tự mới hơn hoặc tốt hơn

senses.definition: to put something back in the place where it was before

examples.x: I replaced the cup carefully in the saucer.
to replace the handset (= after using the phone).

senses.definition_vi: đặt một thứ gì đó trở lại vị trí ban đầu của nó

senses.definition: the act of replacing one thing with another, especially something that is newer or better

examples.x: the replacement of worn car parts

senses.definition_vi: hành động thay thế cái này bằng cái khác, đặc biệt là thứ gì đó mới hơn hoặc tốt hơn

senses.definition: a thing that replaces something, especially because the first thing is old, broken, etc.

examples.x: She had a hip replacement six years ago.
If your passport is stolen you should apply for a replacement immediately.
replacement windows

senses.definition_vi: một thứ thay thế một thứ gì đó, đặc biệt là vì thứ đầu tiên đã cũ, bị hỏng, v.v.

senses.definition: a person who replaces another person in an organization, especially in their job

examples.x: We need to find a replacement for Sue.

senses.definition_vi: một người thay thế người khác trong một tổ chức, đặc biệt là trong công việc của họ

senses.definition: an act of replying to something/somebody in speech, writing or by some action

examples.x: I asked her what her name was but she made no reply.
I received a reply from the firm's managing director.
I got some interesting replies to my post about online banking.
I am writing in reply to your letter of 16 March.
a reply-paid envelope (= on which you do not have to put a stamp because it has already been paid for)
Morocco scored four goals without reply to win the game.

senses.definition_vi: hành động trả lời một cái gì đó/ai đó bằng lời nói, chữ viết hoặc bằng một hành động nào đó

senses.definition: to say or write something as an answer to somebody/something

examples.x: She didn't even bother to reply.
He was quick to reply.
to reply to a question/an email/a query
He hasn't replied to any of my text messages.
She usually replies immediately to comments on her posts.
She simply replied with a smile.
He replied to her question with a scowl.
‘I won't let you down,’ he replied confidently.
The senator replied that he was not in a position to comment.

senses.definition_vi: nói hoặc viết điều gì đó để trả lời ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: to do something as a reaction to something that somebody has said or done

examples.x: Italy took an early lead but Brazil replied with two goals in the last five minutes.
The terrorists replied to the government's statement with more violence.

senses.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó như một phản ứng đối với điều gì đó mà ai đó đã nói hoặc làm

senses.definition: a written or spoken account of an event, especially one that is published or broadcast

examples.x: Are these news reports true?
media/press/newspaper reports
And now over to Jim Muir, for a report on the South African election.
A local news station aired a special report on the controversy.
According to this evening's weather report, there will be snow tomorrow.

senses.definition_vi: một bản tường thuật bằng văn bản hoặc lời nói về một sự kiện, đặc biệt là một sự kiện được xuất bản hoặc phát sóng

senses.definition: a spoken or written description of something containing information that somebody needs to have

examples.x: a police report
The company has just released its annual report.
Can you give us a progress report?
You need to compile a report on your findings.

senses.definition_vi: mô tả bằng lời nói hoặc văn bản về một điều gì đó chứa thông tin mà ai đó cần biết

senses.definition: an official document written by a group of people who have examined a particular situation or problem

examples.x: to release/issue a report
The committee will publish its report on the health service next week.
According to the report, we are facing an obesity crisis.

senses.definition_vi: một tài liệu chính thức do một nhóm người viết, những người đã xem xét một tình huống hoặc vấn đề cụ thể

senses.definition: a story or piece of information that may or may not be true

examples.x: There are unconfirmed reports of a shooting in the capital.
I don't believe these reports of UFO sightings.
We are hearing reports that she has quit.
Despite reports claiming the market is heading for a crash, he predicts that prices will rise.

senses.definition_vi: một câu chuyện hoặc mẩu tin tức có thể đúng hoặc không đúng

senses.definition: a written statement about a student’s work at school, college, etc.

examples.x: a school report
to get a good/bad report
She got a better report card this time.

senses.definition_vi: một bản ghi bằng văn bản về kết quả học tập của học sinh tại trường học, cao đẳng, v.v.

senses.definition: an employee whose work is the responsibility of a particular manager

examples.x: a weekly meeting with my direct reports
He was finding one of his reports very difficult to manage.

senses.definition_vi: một nhân viên có công việc là trách nhiệm của một người quản lý cụ thể

senses.definition: the sound of an explosion or of a gun being fired

examples.x: a loud report

senses.definition_vi: âm thanh của một vụ nổ hoặc tiếng súng

senses.definition: talked about by people in a bad/good way
senses.definition_vi: được mọi người nói đến theo cách xấu/tốt

senses.definition: to give people information about something that you have heard, seen, done, etc.

examples.x: The crash happened seconds after the pilot reported engine trouble.
The findings are similar to those reported in previous studies.
The company is expected to report record profits this year.
Call me urgently if you have anything to report.
The committee will report on its research next month.
He regularly reports on his activities to his family.
The neighbours reported seeing him leave the building around noon.
Six months later, an inspector reported the problem recurring.
The doctor reported the patient fully recovered.
The house was reported as being in excellent condition.
The house was reported to be in excellent condition.
She was reported by the hospital spokesman to be making excellent progress.
Employers reported that graduates were deficient in writing and problem-solving skills.
She failed to report what had occurred.
‘The cabin's empty,’ he reported.

senses.definition_vi: cung cấp cho mọi người thông tin về điều gì đó mà bạn đã nghe, nhìn thấy, làm, v.v.

senses.definition: to present a written or spoken account of an event in a newspaper, on television, etc.

examples.x: The stabbing was widely reported in the press.
Our job is to report the news, not to create it.
The TV news reported that several people had been arrested.
As previously reported, Norfolk police are investigating the case.
It was reported that several people had been arrested.
The media reported me as saying things I did not say.
She reports on royal stories for the BBC.
She has reported from many war zones.
This is Andrew Black reporting for Channel 4 News.

senses.definition_vi: trình bày một bản ghi chép bằng văn bản hoặc lời nói về một sự kiện trên báo, truyền hình, v.v.

senses.definition: used to show that something has been stated, and you do not know if it is true or not

examples.x: She is reported to earn over $10 million a year.
The president is reported as saying that he needs a break.
Opinion has been reported as fact.
It was reported that changes were being considered.

senses.definition_vi: được dùng để chỉ ra rằng điều gì đó đã được nêu ra, và bạn không biết liệu nó có đúng hay không

senses.definition: to tell a person in authority about a crime, an accident, an illness, etc. or about something bad that somebody has done

examples.x: Have you reported the incident to the police?
a decrease in the number of reported cases of AIDS
He's already been reported twice for arriving late.

examples.cf: report somebody to somebody for (doing) something
examples.x: She threatened to report him to the authorities for hunting without a licence.
I’m going to report you if you do that again!
She has reported her daughter missing.

senses.definition_vi: thông báo cho người có thẩm quyền về một tội phạm, một tai nạn, một căn bệnh, v.v. hoặc về điều gì đó tồi tệ mà ai đó đã làm

senses.definition: to tell somebody that you have arrived, for example for work or for a meeting with somebody

examples.x: You should report for duty at 9.30 a.m.
Private Smith reporting for duty, sir!
All visitors must report to the reception desk on arrival.
Volunteers have been instructed on where to report.

senses.definition_vi: thông báo cho ai đó rằng bạn đã đến, ví dụ như để làm việc hoặc để gặp ai đó

senses.definition: according to what some people say

examples.x: The band have reportedly decided to split up.
The move, reportedly the President’s idea, has come in for a lot of criticism.

senses.definition_vi: theo những gì một số người nói

senses.definition: a person who collects and reports news for newspapers, radio or television

examples.x: He leaked the story to a news reporter.
He began his career as a newspaper reporter in New York.
She worked as an investigative reporter for a national newspaper.
a reporter from the  ‘New York Times’

senses.definition_vi: một người thu thập và đưa tin tức cho báo chí, đài phát thanh hoặc truyền hình

senses.definition: the presenting of and writing about news on television and radio, and in newspapers

examples.x: accurate/balanced/objective reporting
Reporting restrictions on the trial have been lifted (= it can now legally be reported).

senses.definition_vi: việc trình bày và viết về tin tức trên truyền hình và đài phát thanh, và trên báo chí

senses.definition: to be a member of a group of people and act or speak for them at an event, a meeting, etc.

examples.x: The competition attracted over 500 contestants representing eight different countries.
Local businesses are well represented on the committee (= there are a lot of people from them on the committee).
The opening speech was by Bob Alan representing Amnesty International.
The President was represented at the ceremony by the Vice-President.

senses.definition_vi: là thành viên của một nhóm người và hành động hoặc nói thay cho họ tại một sự kiện, một cuộc họp, v.v.

senses.definition: to act or speak officially for somebody and defend their interests

examples.x: The union represents over 200 000 teachers.
The association was formed to represent the interests of women artists.
Ms Dale is representing the defendant (= is his/her lawyer) in the case.
As an MP, it is my duty to represent my constituents.

senses.definition_vi: hành động hoặc nói thay mặt chính thức cho ai đó và bảo vệ lợi ích của họ

senses.definition: to take part in a sports event for a particular country, city, etc.

examples.x: He's been chosen to represent Scotland in next year's World Cup Finals.

senses.definition_vi: tham gia một sự kiện thể thao cho một quốc gia, thành phố, v.v. cụ thể

senses.definition: to be a symbol of something

examples.x: Each colour on the chart represents a different department.
Wind direction is represented by arrows.
The artist uses doves to represent peace.
It is not clear what these symbols were intended to represent.

senses.definition_vi: là biểu tượng của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to be something

examples.x: This contract represents 20% of the company's annual revenue.
The final figure represents a 12% increase on the number of new jobs created the previous year.
They're investing in low-carbon technologies that represent value for money.
He got rid of anyone who represented a threat to his authority.
This role represents a unique opportunity to further your career in healthcare.
The peace plan represents (= is the result of) weeks of negotiation.

senses.definition_vi: là một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to be present in something to a particular degree

examples.x: Women and men were represented equally on the teams.
Women are disproportionately represented among welfare recipients.

senses.definition_vi: hiện diện trong một cái gì đó ở một mức độ nhất định

senses.definition: to be an example or expression of something

examples.x: The project represents all that is good in the community.
Those comments do not represent the views of us all.
The book purported to represent the lives of ordinary people.

senses.definition_vi: là một ví dụ hoặc sự thể hiện của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to show somebody/something, especially in a picture

examples.x: The carvings represent a hunting scene.
The map represents Italy in the 12th century.
The results are represented in fig. 3 below.
The Egyptian goddess is represented as a woman with cow's horns.

senses.definition_vi: miêu tả ai đó/điều gì đó, đặc biệt là trong một bức tranh

senses.definition: to present or describe somebody/something in a particular way, especially when this may not be fair

examples.x: The king is represented as a villain in the play.
The risks were represented as negligible.
The film represents us as helpless victims.
The film accurately represents the atmosphere of the post-war period.

senses.definition_vi: trình bày hoặc mô tả ai đó/điều gì đó theo một cách cụ thể, đặc biệt là khi điều này có thể không công bằng

senses.definition: to make a formal statement to somebody in authority to make your opinions known or to protest

examples.x: They represented their concerns to the authorities.
He admitted falsely representing to police officers that the car had been stolen.

senses.definition_vi: đưa ra một tuyên bố chính thức cho người có thẩm quyền để bày tỏ ý kiến của bạn hoặc để phản đối

senses.definition: the act of presenting somebody/something in a particular way; something that shows or describes something

examples.x: the negative representation of single mothers in the media
The snake swallowing its tail is a representation of infinity.

senses.definition_vi: hành động trình bày ai đó/điều gì đó theo một cách cụ thể; một cái gì đó cho thấy hoặc mô tả một cái gì đó

senses.definition: the fact of having representatives who will speak or vote for you or act in your place

examples.x: The green movement lacks effective representation in Parliament.
The accused was not allowed legal representation.

senses.definition_vi: việc có những người đại diện sẽ phát biểu hoặc bỏ phiếu cho bạn hoặc hành động thay bạn

senses.definition: formal statements made to somebody in authority, especially in order to make your opinions known or to protest

examples.x: We have made representations to the prime minister, but without success.

senses.definition_vi: các tuyên bố chính thức được đưa ra cho người có thẩm quyền, đặc biệt là để bày tỏ ý kiến của bạn hoặc để phản đối

senses.definition: typical of a particular group of people; that is a typical example of something

examples.x: Is a questionnaire answered by 500 people truly representative of the population as a whole?
The paper-thin models in magazines are not representative of most women.
Some residents argued that the protesters were not representative of the community.
The painting is not representative of his work of the period.

senses.definition_vi: điển hình cho một nhóm người cụ thể; là một ví dụ điển hình của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: containing or including examples of all the different types of people or things in a large group

examples.x: We interviewed a representative sample of teachers.
Exhibits include a widely representative collection of Greek vases.

senses.definition_vi: chứa đựng hoặc bao gồm các ví dụ về tất cả các loại người hoặc sự vật trong một nhóm lớn

senses.definition: consisting of people who have been chosen to speak or vote for the rest of a group

examples.x: a representative democracy
the advent of modern representative government

senses.definition_vi: bao gồm những người đã được chọn để phát biểu hoặc bỏ phiếu cho phần còn lại của một nhóm

senses.definition: a person who has been chosen to speak or vote for somebody else or for a group of people, or to take the place of somebody else

examples.x: Our elected representatives in government should be doing something about this.
Management are obliged to consult with union representatives about changes to conditions.
The actor's legal representatives have strongly denied the allegations.
He was the Queen's representative at the ceremony.
a representative of the UN
The committee includes representatives from industry.

senses.definition_vi: một người đã được chọn để phát biểu hoặc bỏ phiếu cho người khác hoặc cho một nhóm người, hoặc để thay thế người khác

senses.definition: a person who works for a company and travels around selling its products

examples.x: a sales representative
She's our representative in France.

senses.definition_vi: một người làm việc cho một công ty và đi khắp nơi bán sản phẩm của công ty đó

senses.definition: a person who is typical of a particular group

examples.x: The singer is regarded as a representative of the youth of her generation.

senses.definition_vi: một người điển hình cho một nhóm người cụ thể

senses.definition: (in the US) a member of the House of Representatives, the Lower House of Congress; a member of the House of Representatives in the lower house of a state parliament
senses.definition_vi: (ở Mỹ) một thành viên của Hạ viện, Hạ viện của Quốc hội; một thành viên của Hạ viện trong hạ viện của một nghị viện tiểu bang

senses.definition: to make a copy of a picture, piece of text, etc.

examples.x: It is illegal to reproduce these worksheets without permission from the publisher.
The photocopier reproduces colours very well.
This material can be reproduced without payment.
All illustrations are reproduced by kind permission of the Mercury Gallery.

senses.definition_vi: tạo một bản sao của một bức tranh, một đoạn văn bản, v.v.

senses.definition: to produce something very similar to something else in a different medium or context; to make something happen again in the same way

examples.x: The atmosphere of the novel is successfully reproduced in the movie.
Unfortunately, he was never able to reproduce this level of performance in a competition.
I was able to reproduce the same results with subsequent tests.

senses.definition_vi: sản xuất một cái gì đó rất giống với một cái gì đó khác trong một phương tiện hoặc bối cảnh khác; làm cho một cái gì đó xảy ra lần nữa theo cùng một cách

senses.definition: if people, plants, animals, etc. reproduce or reproduce themselves, they produce young

examples.x: Most reptiles reproduce by laying eggs on land.
cells reproducing themselves (= making new ones)

senses.definition_vi: nếu người, thực vật, động vật, v.v. sinh sản hoặc tự sinh sản, chúng tạo ra con non

senses.definition: the act or process of producing babies, young animals or plants

examples.x: sexual reproduction
They are studying reproduction in shellfish.

senses.definition_vi: hành động hoặc quá trình sinh con, con non hoặc thực vật

senses.definition: the act or process of producing copies of a document, book, picture, etc.

examples.x: Use a black pen on white paper to ensure good reproduction.

senses.definition_vi: hành động hoặc quá trình tạo bản sao của một tài liệu, sách, tranh ảnh, v.v.

senses.definition: the quality of recorded sound

examples.x: Digital recording gives excellent sound reproduction.

senses.definition_vi: chất lượng của âm thanh được ghi lại

senses.definition: a thing that has been reproduced, especially a copy of a work of art

examples.x: They have a catalogue with colour reproductions of the paintings for sale.
reproduction furniture (= furniture made as a copy of an earlier style)

senses.definition_vi: một thứ đã được sao chép, đặc biệt là bản sao của một tác phẩm nghệ thuật

senses.definition: a country that is governed by a president and politicians elected by the people and where there is no king or queen

examples.x: newly independent republics
Mary McAleese has been the President of the Republic of Ireland since 1997.

senses.definition_vi: một quốc gia được cai trị bởi một tổng thống và các chính trị gia được bầu bởi người dân và không có vua hoặc nữ hoàng

senses.definition: the opinion that people have about what somebody/something is like, based on what has happened in the past

examples.x: to have a good/bad reputation
to build/earn a reputation
She soon established a reputation as a first-class cook.
The company enjoys an international reputation for quality of design.
a politician with a reputation for honesty
I'm aware of Mark's reputation for being late.
He has the reputation of being a hard worker.
to damage/tarnish/ruin somebody’s reputation
The weather in England is living up to its reputation (= is exactly as expected).
She is, by reputation, very difficult to please.

senses.definition_vi: ý kiến của mọi người về việc ai đó/điều gì đó như thế nào, dựa trên những gì đã xảy ra trong quá khứ

senses.definition: the action of asking for something formally and politely; a thing that you formally ask for

examples.x: a request for information
They made a request for further aid.
He submitted a request to adopt a flexible working routine.
to grant a request
to refuse/decline/reject/deny a request
She went to the wedding at her mother's request (= because her mother had asked her to go).
He was there at the request of his manager (= because his manager had asked him to go).
The writer's name was withheld by request (= because the writer asked for this to be done).
Application forms are available on request.
She left her address with a request that any mail should be sent on to her.

senses.definition_vi: hành động yêu cầu một cái gì đó một cách trang trọng và lịch sự; một thứ mà bạn yêu cầu một cách trang trọng

senses.definition: an instruction to a computer to perform a task

examples.x: When the software has finished processing the request, a download window pops up.

senses.definition_vi: một chỉ dẫn cho máy tính thực hiện một nhiệm vụ

senses.definition: a song or tune that somebody asks to have played on a radio programme

examples.x: The next request is from a listener in Aberdeen.
a radio request programme

senses.definition_vi: một bài hát hoặc giai điệu mà ai đó yêu cầu được phát trên chương trình phát thanh

senses.definition: to ask for something or ask somebody to do something in a polite or formal way

examples.x: She requested permission to film at the White House.
You can request a free copy of the leaflet.
She requested anonymity because she wasn't authorized to speak to the press.
The government has requested information from the companies involved in the scandal.
Visitors are requested not to touch the exhibits.
We were requested to assemble in the lobby.
She requested that no one be told of her decision until the next meeting.
She requested that no one should be told of her decision.
‘Please come with me,’ he requested.

senses.definition_vi: hỏi xin thứ gì đó hoặc yêu cầu ai đó làm gì đó một cách lịch sự hoặc trang trọng

senses.definition: to need something; to depend on somebody/something

examples.x: These pets require a lot of care and attention.
Deciphering the code requires an expert.
This condition requires urgent treatment.
Do you require anything else? (= in a shop/store, for example)
These plants absolutely require shade.
True marriage requires us to show trust and loyalty.
The situation required that he be present.
The situation required that he should be present.
Lentils do not require soaking before cooking.

senses.definition_vi: cần thứ gì đó; phụ thuộc vào ai đó/thứ gì đó

senses.definition: to make somebody do or have something, especially because it is necessary according to a particular law or set of rules

examples.x: I just require a signature on the form.
The wearing of seat belts is required by law.
‘Hamlet’ is required reading (= must be read) for this course.
Several students failed to reach the required standard.
What exactly is required of a receptionist (= what are they expected to do)?
All candidates will be required to take a short test.
All adults are legally required to pay the tax.
We require that you comply with the following rules:…
The law requires that everyone wear a seat belt.

senses.definition_vi: bắt buộc ai đó làm hoặc có thứ gì đó, đặc biệt là vì điều đó là cần thiết theo một luật hoặc bộ quy tắc cụ thể

senses.definition: something that you need or want

examples.x: the basic requirements of life
a software solution to meet your requirements
All products can be customized to suit your specific requirements.
Our immediate requirement is extra staff.
These goods are surplus to requirements (= more than we need).

senses.definition_vi: thứ bạn cần hoặc muốn

senses.definition: something that you must have in order to do something else

examples.x: to meet/fulfil/satisfy the requirements
What is the minimum entry requirement for this course?
Banks now face stricter regulatory requirements.

senses.definition_vi: thứ bạn phải có để làm việc khác

senses.definition: the act of saving somebody/something from a dangerous or difficult situation; the fact of being saved

examples.x: We had given up hope of rescue.
A wealthy benefactor came to their rescue with a generous donation.
a rescue operation/mission
a mountain rescue team
rescue helicopters/boats/workers
The United Nations is helping to coordinate rescue efforts.

senses.definition_vi: hành động cứu ai đó/thứ gì đó khỏi tình huống nguy hiểm hoặc khó khăn; việc được cứu

senses.definition: an occasion when somebody/something is saved from a dangerous or difficult situation

examples.x: Ten fishermen were saved in a daring sea rescue.
Her own boat capsized after she attempted a rescue.

senses.definition_vi: một dịp ai đó/thứ gì đó được cứu khỏi tình huống nguy hiểm hoặc khó khăn

senses.definition: to save somebody/something from a dangerous or harmful situation

examples.x: The coastguard rescued six people from the sinking boat.
The woman was rescued from her burning home by firefighters.
You rescued me from an embarrassing situation.
The house was rescued from demolition.
He rescued a child from drowning.
The hostages were rescued and brought to safety.
The shelter rescues stray dogs.
She had despaired of ever being rescued alive.

senses.definition_vi: cứu ai đó/thứ gì đó khỏi tình huống nguy hiểm hoặc có hại

senses.definition: a careful study of a subject, especially in order to discover new facts or information about it

examples.x: scientific/medical/academic research
They are raising money for cancer research.
to do/conduct/undertake research
I've done some research to find out the cheapest way of travelling there.
He has carried out extensive research into renewable energy sources.
Recent research on deaf children has produced some interesting findings about their speech.
Research on animals has led to some important medical advances.
According to recent research, more people are going to the movies than ever before.
Their latest research project will be funded by the government.
Are you hoping to get a research grant?
a research fellow/assistant/scientist
a research institute/centre/laboratory
The research findings were published in the Journal of Environmental Quality.

senses.definition_vi: một nghiên cứu cẩn thận về một chủ đề, đặc biệt là để khám phá các sự kiện hoặc thông tin mới về nó

senses.definition: to study something carefully and try to discover new facts about it

examples.x: to research a topic/subject
She's in New York researching her new book (= finding facts and information to put in it).
They began researching potential buyers for their product.
The book has been meticulously/exhaustively/thoroughly researched.
They spent days researching in the school library.
We have to research how the product will actually be used.

senses.definition_vi: nghiên cứu cẩn thận một điều gì đó và cố gắng khám phá các sự kiện mới về nó

senses.definition: a person who studies something carefully and tries to discover new facts about it

examples.x: European researchers say olive oil could help prevent cancer.
Researchers found there was no evidence of an increased risk of infection.
The study was carried out by researchers at Bristol University.
a leading researcher in the field of artificial intelligence
researchers in psychology

senses.definition_vi: một người nghiên cứu cẩn thận một điều gì đó và cố gắng khám phá các sự kiện mới về nó

senses.definition: to look like or be similar to another person or thing

examples.x: She closely resembles her sister.
So many hotels resemble each other.
The plant resembles grass in appearance.

senses.definition_vi: trông giống hoặc tương tự như người hoặc vật khác

senses.definition: an arrangement for a seat on a plane or train, a room in a hotel, etc. to be kept for you

examples.x: I'll call the restaurant and make a reservation.
We have a reservation in the name of Grant.
I had to cancel my hotel reservation.

senses.definition_vi: một sự sắp xếp để giữ chỗ trên máy bay hoặc tàu, phòng khách sạn, v.v. cho bạn

senses.definition: a feeling of doubt about a plan or an idea

examples.x: I have serious reservations about his ability to do the job.
They support the measures without reservation (= completely).

senses.definition_vi: một cảm giác nghi ngờ về một kế hoạch hoặc ý tưởng

senses.definition: an area of land in the US that is kept separate for native North Americans to live in
senses.definition_vi: một khu vực đất ở Hoa Kỳ được dành riêng cho người bản địa Bắc Mỹ sinh sống

senses.definition: (in India) the policy of keeping a fixed number of jobs or places in schools, colleges, etc. for people who are members of scheduled castes, scheduled tribes or other backward classes
senses.definition_vi: (ở Ấn Độ) chính sách giữ một số lượng cố định các công việc hoặc chỗ trong trường học, cao đẳng, v.v. cho những người thuộc các đẳng cấp theo lịch trình, bộ lạc theo lịch trình hoặc các tầng lớp kém phát triển khác

senses.definition: a supply of something that is available to be used in the future or when it is needed

examples.x: cash/foreign currency reserves
large oil and gas reserves
reserve funds
He discovered unexpected reserves of strength.
The country has the world's largest reserves of coal.
The company has substantial reserves of capital.

senses.definition_vi: một nguồn cung cấp thứ gì đó có sẵn để sử dụng trong tương lai hoặc khi cần thiết

senses.definition: a piece of land that is a protected area for animals, plants, etc.

examples.x: a wildlife/forest reserve

senses.definition_vi: một mảnh đất là khu vực được bảo vệ cho động vật, thực vật, v.v.

senses.definition: an area of land in the US that is kept separate for native North Americans to live in
senses.definition_vi: một khu vực đất ở Hoa Kỳ được dành riêng cho người bản địa Bắc Mỹ sinh sống

senses.definition: the quality that somebody has when they do not talk easily to other people about their ideas, feelings, etc.

examples.x: She found it difficult to make friends because of her natural reserve.
Jaime always talked to people without reserve.

senses.definition_vi: phẩm chất mà ai đó có khi họ không dễ dàng nói với người khác về ý tưởng, cảm xúc của họ, v.v.

senses.definition: a feeling that you do not want to accept or agree to something, etc. until you are quite sure that it is all right to do so

examples.x: Any contract should be treated with reserve until it has been checked.
She trusted him without reserve (= completely).

senses.definition_vi: một cảm giác không muốn chấp nhận hoặc đồng ý với điều gì đó, v.v. cho đến khi bạn khá chắc chắn rằng điều đó là ổn

senses.definition: an extra player who plays in a team when one of the other players is injured or not available to play
senses.definition_vi: một cầu thủ bổ sung chơi trong một đội khi một trong những cầu thủ khác bị thương hoặc không có sẵn để chơi

senses.definition: a team that is below the level of the main team
senses.definition_vi: một đội ở dưới cấp độ của đội chính

senses.definition: an extra military force, etc. that is not part of a country’s regular forces, but is available to be used when needed

examples.x: the Army Reserve
the reserve police

senses.definition_vi: một lực lượng quân sự bổ sung, v.v. không thuộc lực lượng chính quy của một quốc gia, nhưng có sẵn để sử dụng khi cần thiết

senses.definition: the lowest price that somebody will accept for something, especially something that is sold at an auction

examples.x: The painting failed to reach to its reserve and was withdrawn from the sale.

senses.definition_vi: mức giá thấp nhất mà ai đó sẽ chấp nhận cho một thứ gì đó, đặc biệt là thứ gì đó được bán đấu giá

senses.definition: available to be used in the future or when needed

examples.x: The money was being kept in reserve for their retirement.
200 police officers were held in reserve.

senses.definition_vi: có sẵn để sử dụng trong tương lai hoặc khi cần thiết

senses.definition: to ask for a seat, table, room, etc. to be available for you or somebody else at a future time

examples.x: I'd like to reserve a table for three for eight o'clock.
I've reserved a room in the name of Jones.

senses.definition_vi: yêu cầu giữ chỗ, bàn, phòng, v.v. có sẵn cho bạn hoặc người khác vào một thời điểm trong tương lai

senses.definition: to keep something for somebody/something, so that it cannot be used by any other person or for any other reason

examples.x: These seats are reserved for special guests.
The team captain reserved special praise for his players after the match.
She said this in the tone of voice she reserved for addressing small children.

senses.definition_vi: giữ lại thứ gì đó cho ai đó/thứ gì đó, để nó không thể bị người khác hoặc vì lý do khác sử dụng

senses.definition: to have or keep a particular power

examples.x: The management reserves the right to refuse admission.
All rights reserved (= nobody else can publish or copy this).

senses.definition_vi: có hoặc giữ một quyền lực cụ thể

senses.definition: to not decide or make a judgement about something until a later time

examples.x: I'd prefer to reserve judgement until I know all the facts.
Three judges have decided to reserve their decision until a later date.

senses.definition_vi: không quyết định hoặc đưa ra phán xét về điều gì đó cho đến một thời điểm sau

senses.definition: to live in a particular place

examples.x: He returned to Britain in 1939, having resided abroad for many years.
Their passports do not give them the right to reside in Britain.

senses.definition_vi: sống ở một nơi cụ thể

senses.definition: a house, especially a large or impressive one

examples.x: a desirable family residence for sale (= for example, in an advertisement)
10 Downing Street is the British Prime Minister’s official residence.

senses.definition_vi: một ngôi nhà, đặc biệt là một ngôi nhà lớn hoặc ấn tượng

senses.definition: the state of living in a particular place

examples.x: They were not able to take up residence in their new home until the spring.
Please state your occupation and place of residence.
The flag flies when the Queen is in residence.

senses.definition_vi: tình trạng sống ở một nơi cụ thể

senses.definition: permission to live in a country that is not your own

examples.x: They have been denied residence in this country.
a residence permit

senses.definition_vi: sự cho phép sống ở một quốc gia không phải của mình

senses.definition: having an official position in a particular place such as a college or university

examples.x: creative writing classes given by the writer in residence

senses.definition_vi: có một vị trí chính thức tại một địa điểm cụ thể như trường cao đẳng hoặc đại học

senses.definition: living in a particular place

examples.x: the town’s resident population (= not tourists or visitors)
to be resident abroad/in the UK
Tom's our resident expert (= our own expert) on foreign movies.

senses.definition_vi: sống ở một nơi cụ thể

senses.definition: a person who lives in a particular place or who has their home there

examples.x: a resident of the United States
The proposals sparked concern among local residents.

senses.definition_vi: một người sống ở một nơi cụ thể hoặc có nhà ở đó

senses.definition: a person who is staying in a hotel

examples.x: The hotel restaurant is open to non-residents.

senses.definition_vi: một người đang ở tại khách sạn

senses.definition: a doctor working in a hospital in the US who is receiving special advanced training
senses.definition_vi: một bác sĩ làm việc tại bệnh viện ở Hoa Kỳ đang được đào tạo chuyên sâu đặc biệt

senses.definition: suitable for living in; consisting of houses rather than factories or offices

examples.x: a quiet residential area

senses.definition_vi: thích hợp để sinh sống; bao gồm nhà ở thay vì nhà máy hoặc văn phòng

senses.definition: requiring a person to live at a particular place; offering living accommodation

examples.x: a residential language course
a residential home for the elderly
residential care for children

senses.definition_vi: yêu cầu một người sống tại một địa điểm cụ thể; cung cấp chỗ ở

senses.definition: a small amount of something that remains at the end of a process

examples.x: pesticide residues in fruit and vegetables

senses.definition_vi: một lượng nhỏ của thứ gì đó còn lại vào cuối một quá trình

senses.definition: the part of the money, property, etc. of a person who has died that remains after all the debts, gifts, etc. have been paid

examples.x: The residue of the estate was divided equally among his children.

senses.definition_vi: phần tiền, tài sản, v.v. của một người đã chết còn lại sau khi đã thanh toán hết các khoản nợ, quà tặng, v.v.

senses.definition: to officially tell somebody that you are leaving your job, an organization, etc.

examples.x: She was forced to resign due to ill health.
He resigned as manager after eight years.
Two members resigned from the board in protest.
Some judges have threatened to resign over this issue.
My father resigned his directorship last year.

senses.definition_vi: chính thức thông báo cho ai đó rằng bạn đang rời bỏ công việc, tổ chức, v.v.

senses.definition: the act of giving up your job or position; the occasion when you do this

examples.x: a letter of resignation
There were calls for her resignation from the board of directors.
Further resignations are expected.
The defeat led to his resignation as team manager.

senses.definition_vi: hành động từ bỏ công việc hoặc vị trí của bạn; dịp bạn làm điều này

senses.definition: a letter, for example to your employers, to say that you are giving up your job or position

examples.x: to offer/hand in/tender your resignation
We haven't received his resignation yet.

senses.definition_vi: một lá thư, ví dụ gửi cho người sử dụng lao động của bạn, để nói rằng bạn đang từ bỏ công việc hoặc vị trí của mình

senses.definition: the quality of being willing to accept a difficult or unpleasant situation that you cannot change

examples.x: They accepted their defeat with resignation.

senses.definition_vi: phẩm chất sẵn sàng chấp nhận một tình huống khó khăn hoặc khó chịu mà bạn không thể thay đổi

senses.definition: to refuse to accept something and try to stop it from happening

examples.x: They are determined to resist pressure to change the law.
People naturally resist change.
The bank strongly resisted cutting interest rates.
Residents who oppose the plans are threatening to resist.

senses.definition_vi: từ chối chấp nhận điều gì đó và cố gắng ngăn chặn nó xảy ra

senses.definition: to fight back when attacked; to use force to stop something from happening

examples.x: He tried to pin me down, but I resisted.
She was charged with resisting arrest.

senses.definition_vi: chống trả khi bị tấn công; sử dụng vũ lực để ngăn chặn điều gì đó xảy ra

senses.definition: to stop yourself from having something you like or doing something you very much want to do

examples.x: I finished the cake. I couldn't resist it.
The Chancellor resisted the temptation to raise business taxes.
I found the temptation to miss the class too hard to resist.
She could hardly resist the urge to turn and run.
He couldn't resist showing off his new car.

senses.definition_vi: ngăn bản thân có được thứ mình thích hoặc làm điều mình rất muốn làm

senses.definition: to not be harmed or damaged by something

examples.x: A healthy diet should help your body resist infection.
The castle was built to resist attack.

senses.definition_vi: không bị tổn hại hoặc hư hại bởi điều gì đó

senses.definition: dislike of or opposition to a plan, an idea, etc.; the act of refusing to obey

examples.x: As with all new ideas it met with resistance.
There has been a lot of resistance to this new law.
Resistance to change has nearly destroyed the industry.

senses.definition_vi: sự không thích hoặc phản đối một kế hoạch, một ý tưởng, v.v.; hành động từ chối tuân theo

senses.definition: the act of using force to oppose somebody/something

examples.x: There were a number of episodes of armed resistance during the early years of occupation.
The defenders put up a strong resistance.
The demonstrators offered little or no resistance to the police.

senses.definition_vi: hành động sử dụng vũ lực để chống lại ai đó/điều gì đó

senses.definition: the power not to be affected by something

examples.x: AIDS lowers the body's resistance to infection.

senses.definition_vi: khả năng không bị ảnh hưởng bởi điều gì đó

senses.definition: a force that stops something moving or makes it move more slowly

examples.x: wind/air resistance (= in the design of planes or cars)

senses.definition_vi: một lực ngăn cản vật gì đó di chuyển hoặc làm nó di chuyển chậm hơn

senses.definition: the opposition of a substance or device to the flow of an electrical current
senses.definition_vi: sự đối kháng của một chất hoặc thiết bị với dòng điện

senses.definition: a secret organization that resists the authorities, especially in a country that an enemy has control of

examples.x: resistance fighters
The Resistance was/were not going to surrender.

senses.definition_vi: một tổ chức bí mật chống lại chính quyền, đặc biệt là ở một quốc gia bị kẻ thù kiểm soát

senses.definition: (to choose, etc.) the easiest way of doing something
senses.definition_vi: cách dễ nhất để làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: a definite decision to do or not to do something

examples.x: Have you made any New Year's resolutions (= for example, to give up smoking from 1 January)?
She made a resolution to visit her relatives more often.

senses.definition_vi: quyết định dứt khoát để làm hoặc không làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: a formal statement of an opinion agreed on by a committee or a council, especially by means of a vote

examples.x: to pass/adopt/approve a resolution
The UN Security Council unanimously adopted a resolution calling for a halt to hostilities.

senses.definition_vi: một tuyên bố chính thức về một ý kiến đã được một ủy ban hoặc hội đồng nhất trí, đặc biệt là bằng một cuộc bỏ phiếu

senses.definition: the act of solving or settling a problem, argument, etc.

examples.x: dispute/conflict resolution
The government is pressing for an early resolution of the dispute.
Hopes of a peaceful resolution to the conflict were fading.

senses.definition_vi: hành động giải quyết hoặc dàn xếp một vấn đề, tranh cãi, v.v.

senses.definition: the quality of being resolute or determined

examples.x: The reforms owe a great deal to the resolution of one man.
Her resolution never faltered.
She showed great resolution in her dealings with management.

senses.definition_vi: phẩm chất kiên quyết hoặc quyết tâm

senses.definition: the power of a computer screen, printer, etc. to give a clear image, depending on the size of the dots (= marks) that make up the image

examples.x: The graphics look fine, even at low resolution.
The higher the resolution, the sharper the image.
a monitor capable of a 1 024 by 768 pixel resolution

senses.definition_vi: khả năng của màn hình máy tính, máy in, v.v. để cho hình ảnh rõ nét, tùy thuộc vào kích thước của các chấm (= dấu) tạo nên hình ảnh

senses.definition: to find an acceptable solution to a problem or difficulty

examples.x: to resolve an issue/a dispute/a conflict/a crisis
Attempts are being made to resolve the problem of security in schools.
Both sides met in order to try to resolve their differences.
We hope to resolve the matter as soon as possible.
Everything is being done to resolve the situation.
The dispute has not been fully resolved.
Be patient and the situation may resolve itself.

senses.definition_vi: tìm một giải pháp chấp nhận được cho một vấn đề hoặc khó khăn

senses.definition: to make a definite decision to do something

examples.x: He resolved not to tell her the truth.
He resolved to do something to help the children he had met.
She resolved that she would never see him again.
We had resolved on making an early start.

senses.definition_vi: đưa ra một quyết định dứt khoát để làm điều gì đó

senses.definition: to reach a decision by means of a formal vote

examples.x: It was resolved that the matter be referred to a higher authority.
They resolved that the matter be referred to a higher authority.
The committee unanimously resolved that the party chairman should step down.
The Supreme Council resolved to resume control over the national press.
The board of directors has called a meeting to resolve on the merger.

senses.definition_vi: đạt được một quyết định bằng một cuộc bỏ phiếu chính thức

senses.definition: a place where a lot of people go on holiday

examples.x: seaside/mountain resorts
They spent a month at a fashionable ski resort in Switzerland.
a popular tourist resort
a popular holiday resort
the resort town of Byron Bay
destination resorts such as Atlantis in the Bahamas

senses.definition_vi: một nơi mà nhiều người đi nghỉ mát

senses.definition: the act of using something, especially something bad or unpleasant, because nothing else is possible

examples.x: There are hopes that the conflict can be resolved without resort to violence.

senses.definition_vi: hành động sử dụng một thứ gì đó, đặc biệt là thứ gì đó xấu hoặc khó chịu, vì không còn cách nào khác

senses.definition: the first or last course of action that you should or can take in a particular situation

examples.x: Strike action should be regarded as a last resort, when all attempts to negotiate have failed.
In the last resort (= in the end) everyone must decide for themselves.

senses.definition_vi: hành động đầu tiên hoặc cuối cùng mà bạn nên hoặc có thể thực hiện trong một tình huống cụ thể

senses.definition: a supply of something that a country, an organization or a person has and can use, especially to increase their wealth

examples.x: the exploitation of minerals and other natural resources
They promote the use of renewable resources like soybean oil.
water/mineral/energy resources
The school does the best it can with limited resources (= money).
a valuable/precious/scarce resource
Think carefully about how you allocate resources.
We agreed to pool our resources (= so that everyone gives something).
Police have had to devote more resources to these cases.

senses.definition_vi: một nguồn cung cấp thứ gì đó mà một quốc gia, một tổ chức hoặc một người có và có thể sử dụng, đặc biệt là để tăng sự giàu có của họ

senses.definition: something that can be used to help achieve an aim, especially a book, equipment, etc. that provides information for teachers and students

examples.x: The website is an invaluable educational resource.
This is an online resource for anyone interested in digital design.
The library is a vast resource for historians of medieval France.
Time is your most valuable resource, especially in examinations.
resource books for teachers
a library resource centre

senses.definition_vi: thứ gì đó có thể được sử dụng để giúp đạt được mục tiêu, đặc biệt là một cuốn sách, thiết bị, v.v. cung cấp thông tin cho giáo viên và học sinh

senses.definition: personal qualities such as courage and imagination that help you deal with difficult situations

examples.x: He has no inner resources and hates being alone.
She is someone of considerable personal resources.

senses.definition_vi: phẩm chất cá nhân như lòng dũng cảm và trí tưởng tượng giúp bạn đối phó với những tình huống khó khăn

senses.definition: a strong feeling of approval of somebody/something because of their good qualities or achievements

examples.x: I have the utmost respect for her and her work.
They feel a deep and mutual respect for each other.
It was a noble effort that deserves respect.
She soon earned the respect of her colleagues.
You did a great job. Respect! (= used to praise somebody)

senses.definition_vi: cảm giác mạnh mẽ tán thành ai đó/điều gì đó vì phẩm chất hoặc thành tích tốt của họ

senses.definition: polite behaviour towards or care for somebody/something that you think is important

examples.x: to show a lack of respect for authority
They have a deep respect for the natural world.
He has no respect for her feelings.
Everyone has a right to be treated with respect.
A two-minute silence was held as a mark of respect.
Out of respect for my friend, I didn't say anything.

senses.definition_vi: hành vi lịch sự đối với hoặc sự quan tâm đến ai đó/điều gì đó mà bạn cho là quan trọng

senses.definition: a particular aspect or detail of something

examples.x: In this respect we are very fortunate.
This has been a difficult year in many respects.
There was one respect, however, in which they differed.

senses.definition_vi: một khía cạnh hoặc chi tiết cụ thể của điều gì đó

senses.definition: about; relating to

examples.x: A writ was served on the firm in respect of their unpaid bill.

senses.definition_vi: về; liên quan đến

senses.definition: in payment for something

examples.x: money received in respect of overtime worked

senses.definition_vi: để thanh toán cho điều gì đó

senses.definition: to visit somebody or to send a message of good wishes as a sign of respect for them

examples.x: Many came to pay their last respects (= by attending somebody's funeral).

senses.definition_vi: thăm ai đó hoặc gửi một thông điệp chúc mừng như một dấu hiệu tôn trọng đối với họ

senses.definition: used when you are going to disagree, usually quite strongly, with somebody

examples.x: With all due respect, the figures simply do not support you on this.
With all due respect, I think you've misunderstood what he said.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn sắp không đồng ý, thường là khá mạnh mẽ, với ai đó

senses.definition: in connection with

examples.x: The two groups were similar with respect to income and status.

senses.definition_vi: liên quan đến

senses.definition: to have a very good opinion of somebody/something; to admire somebody/something

examples.x: I respect Jack's opinion on most subjects.
She was a much loved and highly respected teacher.
She had always been honest with me, and I respect her for that.

senses.definition_vi: có ấn tượng rất tốt về ai/cái gì; ngưỡng mộ ai/cái gì

senses.definition: to be careful about something; to make sure you do not do something that might be considered wrong

examples.x: Employers must respect employees' privacy.
to respect other people’s property
I respect your right to disagree.
She promised to respect our wishes.

senses.definition_vi: cẩn thận về điều gì đó; đảm bảo bạn không làm điều gì đó có thể bị coi là sai trái

senses.definition: to agree not to break a law, principle, etc.

examples.x: The new leader has promised to respect the constitution.
The government has promised to respect human rights.

senses.definition_vi: đồng ý không vi phạm một luật lệ, nguyên tắc, v.v.

senses.definition: belonging or relating separately to each of the people or things already mentioned

examples.x: They are each recognized specialists in their respective fields.
the respective roles of men and women in society

senses.definition_vi: thuộc về hoặc liên quan riêng biệt đến từng người hoặc từng vật đã được đề cập

senses.definition: in the same order as the people or things already mentioned

examples.x: Julie and Mark, aged 17 and 19 respectively

senses.definition_vi: theo cùng một thứ tự như những người hoặc những vật đã được đề cập

senses.definition: to give a spoken or written answer to somebody/something

examples.x: I asked him his name, but he didn't respond.
The government did not respond to our questions.
She never responded to my letter.
‘I'm not sure,’ she responded.
When asked about the company's future, the director responded that he remained optimistic.
He responded with a question.

senses.definition_vi: đưa ra câu trả lời bằng lời nói hoặc bằng văn bản cho ai/cái gì

senses.definition: to do something as a reaction to something that somebody has said or done

examples.x: How did they respond to the news?
to respond to a call/need/demand
The public is responding positively to these changes.
to respond favourably/enthusiastically
The government responded by banning all future demonstrations.
The audience responded with enthusiasm.

senses.definition_vi: làm điều gì đó để phản ứng lại điều gì đó mà ai đó đã nói hoặc làm

senses.definition: to react quickly or in the correct way to something/somebody

examples.x: The car responds very well to the controls.
You can rely on him to respond to a challenge.
Our company is small enough to respond quickly.
He tried to move but his body wouldn't respond.

senses.definition_vi: phản ứng nhanh hoặc đúng cách với ai/cái gì

senses.definition: to improve as a result of a particular kind of treatment

examples.x: The infection did not respond to the drugs.

senses.definition_vi: cải thiện kết quả của một loại điều trị cụ thể

senses.definition: a spoken or written answer

examples.x: She made no response.
We have asked for a meeting and we are awaiting a response.
I received an immediate response to my request.
Here's a quick response to your question.
I am writing in response to your enquiry.
Jack just nodded in response.
We sent out over 1 000 letters but the response rate has been low (= few people replied).

senses.definition_vi: một câu trả lời bằng lời nói hoặc bằng văn bản

senses.definition: a reaction to something that has happened or been said

examples.x: The news provoked an angry response.
to elicit/trigger/evoke a response
When I suggested changes, I got a very positive response.
I knocked on the door but there was no response.
There has been little response to our appeal for funds.
The product was developed in response to demand.

senses.definition_vi: sự phản ứng với điều gì đó đã xảy ra hoặc đã được nói

senses.definition: a part of a church service that the people sing or speak as an answer to the part that the priest sings or speaks

examples.x: The congregation sang the responses.

senses.definition_vi: một phần của buổi lễ nhà thờ mà mọi người hát hoặc nói để đáp lại phần mà linh mục hát hoặc nói

senses.definition: a duty to deal with or take care of somebody/something, so that you may be blamed if something goes wrong

examples.x: to be in a position of responsibility
It's time for someone to take responsibility and get the job done.
She assumed responsibility for recruitment.
We are recruiting a sales manager with responsibility for the European market.
They have responsibility for ensuring the rules are enforced.
The responsibility for doing this rests with the department managers.
It is their responsibility to ensure the rules are enforced.
parental rights and responsibilities
She is no longer able to fulfil her responsibilities.
I did it on my own responsibility (= without being told to and being willing to take the blame if it had gone wrong).

senses.definition_vi: nhiệm vụ xử lý hoặc chăm sóc ai/cái gì, để bạn có thể bị đổ lỗi nếu có điều gì đó sai

senses.definition: blame for something bad that has happened

examples.x: The bank refuses to accept responsibility for the mistake.
Nobody has claimed responsibility for the bombing.
It is for the court to decide who bears responsibility.
We take full responsibility for any errors in the text.

senses.definition_vi: lỗi lầm về điều gì đó tồi tệ đã xảy ra

senses.definition: a moral duty to do something or to help or take care of somebody because of your job, position, etc.

examples.x: We want to instil a sense of personal responsibility in children.
She feels a strong sense of responsibility towards her employees.
We have a responsibility to our shareholders.
I think we have a moral responsibility to help these countries.
The media has abdicated its responsibility to report the facts.

senses.definition_vi: một nghĩa vụ đạo đức phải làm điều gì đó hoặc giúp đỡ hoặc chăm sóc ai đó vì công việc, vị trí của bạn, v.v.

senses.definition: having the job or duty of doing something or taking care of somebody/something, so that you may be blamed if something goes wrong

examples.x: Mike is responsible for designing the entire project.
Even where parents no longer live together, they each continue to be responsible for their children.
The management team is directly responsible for the day-to-day operations of the company.
I'd like to talk to whoever is responsible here.

senses.definition_vi: có nhiệm vụ hoặc bổn phận làm điều gì đó hoặc chăm sóc ai/cái gì, để bạn có thể bị đổ lỗi nếu có điều gì đó sai

senses.definition: being able to be blamed for something

examples.x: Who's responsible for this mess?
He is mentally ill and cannot be held responsible for his actions.
We will ensure that anyone found responsible for the accident is held accountable.
Everything will be done to bring those responsible to justice.
You mustn't feel responsible in any way.

senses.definition_vi: có thể bị đổ lỗi về điều gì đó

senses.definition: being the cause of something

examples.x: Cigarette smoking is responsible for about 90 per cent of deaths from lung cancer.
He believes that man-made carbon dioxide is directly responsible for global warming.
Hormonal changes may be partly responsible for these mood swings.

senses.definition_vi: là nguyên nhân của điều gì đó

senses.definition: that you can trust and rely on

examples.x: The child should be accompanied by a parent or other responsible adult.
We need to teach our children to act as responsible citizens.
the importance of using medicines in a responsible manner
Clare has a mature and responsible attitude to work.
The firm specializes in socially responsible investments.
They are not very responsible with money.

senses.definition_vi: có thể tin tưởng và trông cậy vào

senses.definition: needing somebody who can be trusted and relied on; involving important duties

examples.x: a responsible position

senses.definition_vi: cần người có thể tin tưởng và trông cậy; liên quan đến các nhiệm vụ quan trọng

senses.definition: having to report to somebody/something with authority or in a higher position and explain to them what you have done

examples.x: The Council of Ministers is responsible to the Assembly.

senses.definition_vi: phải báo cáo cho ai/cái gì có thẩm quyền hoặc ở vị trí cao hơn và giải thích cho họ những gì bạn đã làm

senses.definition: the part of something that remains

examples.x: Take what you want and throw the rest away.
The country enjoys friendly relations with the rest of the world.
How would you like to spend the rest of the day?
I'm not doing this job for the rest of my life.

senses.definition_vi: phần còn lại của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: the people or things that remain; the others

examples.x: The first question was difficult, but the rest were pretty easy.
Don't blame Alex. He's human, like the rest of us.

senses.definition_vi: những người hoặc những vật còn lại; những người khác

senses.definition: a period of relaxing, sleeping or doing nothing after a period of activity

examples.x: I had a good night's rest.
We stopped for a well-earned rest.
to have/take a rest from all your hard work
Try to get some rest—you have a busy day tomorrow.
There are no matches tomorrow, which is a rest day, but the tournament resumes on Monday.

senses.definition_vi: một khoảng thời gian thư giãn, ngủ hoặc không làm gì sau một khoảng thời gian hoạt động

senses.definition: an object that is used to support or hold something

examples.x: an armrest (= for example on a seat or chair)

senses.definition_vi: một vật được sử dụng để hỗ trợ hoặc giữ một cái gì đó

senses.definition: a period of silence between notes; a sign that shows a rest between notes
senses.definition_vi: một khoảng lặng giữa các nốt nhạc; một dấu hiệu cho thấy một dấu lặng giữa các nốt nhạc

senses.definition: used at the end of a list to mean everything else that you might expect to be on the list

examples.x: He wants a big house and an expensive car and all the rest of it.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng ở cuối danh sách để có nghĩa là tất cả những thứ khác mà bạn có thể mong đợi có trong danh sách

senses.definition: used to say that the actual amount or number of something is much higher than somebody has stated

examples.x: ‘It cost 250 pounds…’ ‘And the rest, and the rest!’

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để nói rằng số lượng hoặc số lượng thực tế của một cái gì đó cao hơn nhiều so với những gì ai đó đã nêu

senses.definition: not moving

examples.x: At rest the insect looks like a dead leaf.

senses.definition_vi: không di chuyển

senses.definition: dead and therefore free from trouble or worry. People say ‘at rest’ to avoid saying ‘dead’.

examples.x: She now lies at rest in the churchyard.

senses.definition_vi: đã chết và do đó thoát khỏi rắc rối hoặc lo lắng. Người ta nói 'yên nghỉ' để tránh nói 'chết'.

senses.definition: to stop moving

examples.x: The car crashed through the barrier and came to rest in a field.
His eyes came to rest on Clara's face.
The ball rolled down the hill and came to rest against a tree.

senses.definition_vi: ngừng di chuyển

senses.definition: apart from that; considering other matters

examples.x: The book has some interesting passages about the author's childhood. For the rest, it is extremely dull.

senses.definition_vi: ngoài điều đó; xem xét các vấn đề khác

senses.definition: used to tell somebody to stop talking about something because they are annoying you

examples.x: Give it a rest! You’ve been complaining all day.

senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng để yêu cầu ai đó ngừng nói về điều gì đó vì họ đang làm bạn khó chịu

senses.definition: to stop doing something for a while
senses.definition_vi: ngừng làm điều gì đó trong một thời gian

senses.definition: to bury somebody. People say ‘to lay somebody to rest’ to avoid saying ‘to bury’ somebody.

examples.x: George was laid to rest beside his parents.

senses.definition_vi: chôn cất ai đó. Người ta nói 'đưa ai đó về nơi an nghỉ cuối cùng' để tránh nói 'chôn cất' ai đó.

senses.definition: to stop something by showing it is not true

examples.x: The announcement finally laid all the speculation about their future to rest.

senses.definition_vi: làm hoặc nói điều gì đó để chứng tỏ điều đó là sai

senses.definition: used when somebody is complaining that they have a lot of work to do
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi ai đó phàn nàn rằng họ có rất nhiều việc phải làm

senses.definition: to do or say something to make somebody stop worrying about something
senses.definition_vi: làm hoặc nói điều gì đó để khiến ai đó ngừng lo lắng về điều gì đó

senses.definition: used when you are telling a story to say that you do not need to tell the end of it, because everyone knows it already
senses.definition_vi: được sử dụng khi bạn đang kể một câu chuyện để nói rằng bạn không cần phải kể hết, vì mọi người đều biết điều đó rồi

senses.definition: to relax, sleep or do nothing after a period of activity or illness; to not use a part of your body for some time

examples.x: The doctor told me to rest.
He won't rest (= will never be satisfied) until he finds her.
He had to rest his injured knee for six weeks.
Rest your eyes every half an hour.

senses.definition_vi: thư giãn, ngủ hoặc không làm gì sau một khoảng thời gian hoạt động hoặc bệnh tật; không sử dụng một bộ phận cơ thể trong một thời gian

senses.definition: to leave a player out of a team for a short period of time

examples.x: The striker has been rested ahead of the final this weekend.
The manager chose to rest some of her star players for the midweek game.

senses.definition_vi: để một cầu thủ không tham gia thi đấu trong một khoảng thời gian ngắn

senses.definition: to support something by putting it on or against something; to be supported in this way

examples.x: Rest your head on my shoulder.
He rested his chin in his hands.
Their bikes were resting against the wall.
I settled back, my hands resting in my lap.

senses.definition_vi: để hỗ trợ một cái gì đó bằng cách đặt nó lên hoặc dựa vào một cái gì đó; được hỗ trợ theo cách này

senses.definition: if you let a matter rest, you stop discussing it or dealing with it

examples.x: The matter cannot rest there—I intend to sue.
And there the matter rested until an interested journalist uncovered the file.

senses.definition_vi: nếu bạn để một vấn đề được nghỉ ngơi, bạn ngừng thảo luận hoặc giải quyết nó

senses.definition: to be buried. People say ‘rest’ to avoid saying ‘be buried’

examples.x: She rests beside her husband in the local cemetery.
May he rest in peace.

senses.definition_vi: được chôn cất. Người ta nói 'rest' để tránh nói 'be buried' (được chôn cất)

senses.definition: to relax and stop worrying

examples.x: You can rest easy—I'm not going to tell anyone.
I can sleep easy knowing that she's safely home.

senses.definition_vi: thư giãn và ngừng lo lắng

senses.definition: used to show respect when you are talking about somebody who is dead
senses.definition_vi: dùng để thể hiện sự tôn trọng khi bạn nói về một người đã chết

senses.definition: used to emphasize that what you say is true or will definitely happen

examples.x: You may rest assured that we will do all we can to find him.

senses.definition_vi: dùng để nhấn mạnh rằng điều bạn nói là đúng hoặc chắc chắn sẽ xảy ra

senses.definition: used to say that you do not need to say any more about something because you think that you have proved your point
senses.definition_vi: dùng để nói rằng bạn không cần nói thêm gì nữa về một điều gì đó vì bạn nghĩ rằng bạn đã chứng minh được quan điểm của mình

senses.definition: used by lawyers in court to say that they have finished presenting their case

examples.x: The prosecution rests its case.

senses.definition_vi: được các luật sư sử dụng tại tòa để nói rằng họ đã trình bày xong vụ việc của mình

senses.definition: to feel so satisfied with what you have already achieved that you do not try to do any more
senses.definition_vi: cảm thấy hài lòng với những gì bạn đã đạt được đến mức bạn không cố gắng làm thêm gì nữa

senses.definition: a place where you can buy and eat a meal

examples.x: We're going to try this Italian restaurant that just opened.
They stopped at a fast-food restaurant on the way to the concert.
We had a meal in a restaurant.
We went to my favourite restaurant to celebrate.
a restaurant chain/owner

senses.definition_vi: một nơi bạn có thể mua và ăn một bữa ăn

senses.definition: the work of repairing and cleaning an old building, a painting, etc. so that its condition is as good as it originally was

examples.x: restoration work
The palace is closed for restoration.

senses.definition_vi: công việc sửa chữa và làm sạch một tòa nhà cũ, một bức tranh, v.v. để tình trạng của nó tốt như ban đầu

senses.definition: the act of bringing back a system, a law, etc. that existed previously

examples.x: the restoration of diplomatic relations between the two countries
the restoration of democracy/the monarchy

senses.definition_vi: hành động đưa trở lại một hệ thống, một luật, v.v. đã tồn tại trước đó

senses.definition: the act of returning something to its correct place, condition or owner

examples.x: the restoration of the Elgin marbles to Greece

senses.definition_vi: hành động trả lại một cái gì đó về đúng vị trí, tình trạng hoặc chủ sở hữu của nó

senses.definition: the time in Britain after 1660 when, following a period with no king or queen, Charles II became king

examples.x: Restoration comedy/poetry (= written during and after this time)

senses.definition_vi: thời kỳ ở Anh sau năm 1660, sau một thời kỳ không có vua hoặc nữ hoàng, Charles II trở thành vua

senses.definition: to bring back a situation or feeling that existed before

examples.x: The measures are intended to restore public confidence in the economy.
Order was quickly restored after the riots.
Such kindness restores your faith in human nature (= makes you believe most people are kind).
The operation restored his sight (= made him able to see again).
Peace has now been restored to the area.

senses.definition_vi: đưa một tình huống hoặc cảm xúc đã tồn tại trước đó trở lại

senses.definition: to bring somebody/something back to a former condition, place or position

examples.x: He is now fully restored to health.
We hope to restore the garden to its former glory (= make it as beautiful as it used to be).
This cream claims to restore your skin to its youthful condition.

senses.definition_vi: đưa ai đó/cái gì đó trở lại tình trạng, vị trí hoặc trạng thái ban đầu

senses.definition: to repair a building, work of art, piece of furniture, etc. so that it looks as good as it did originally

examples.x: Her job is restoring old paintings.
The house has been lovingly restored to the way it looked in 1900 when it was built.

senses.definition_vi: sửa chữa một tòa nhà, tác phẩm nghệ thuật, đồ nội thất, v.v. để nó trông đẹp như ban đầu

senses.definition: to bring a law, tradition, way of working, etc. back into use

examples.x: to restore ancient traditions
Some people argue that the death penalty should be restored.

senses.definition_vi: đưa một luật, truyền thống, cách làm việc, v.v. trở lại sử dụng

senses.definition: to give something that was lost or stolen back to somebody

examples.x: The police have now restored the painting to its rightful owner.

senses.definition_vi: trả lại cho ai đó một thứ đã bị mất hoặc bị đánh cắp

senses.definition: a rule, a fact, an idea, etc. that limits or controls what people can do

examples.x: The government has imposed export restraints on some products.
social restraints on drinking alcohol

senses.definition_vi: một quy tắc, một sự thật, một ý tưởng, v.v. giới hạn hoặc kiểm soát những gì mọi người có thể làm

senses.definition: the act of controlling or limiting something because it is necessary or sensible to do so

examples.x: The unions are unlikely to accept any sort of wage restraint.
They said that they would fight without restraint (= completely freely) for what they wanted.

senses.definition_vi: hành động kiểm soát hoặc giới hạn một cái gì đó vì nó cần thiết hoặc hợp lý để làm như vậy

senses.definition: the quality of behaving calmly and with control

examples.x: The police appealed to the crowd for restraint.
He exercised considerable restraint in ignoring the insults.

senses.definition_vi: phẩm chất cư xử bình tĩnh và có kiểm soát

senses.definition: the use of physical force to control somebody who is behaving in a violent way

examples.x: the physical restraint of prisoners

senses.definition_vi: việc sử dụng vũ lực thể chất để kiểm soát ai đó đang có hành vi bạo lực

senses.definition: a type of seat belt or safety device

examples.x: Children must use an approved child restraint or adult seat belt.

senses.definition_vi: một loại dây an toàn hoặc thiết bị an toàn

senses.definition: to limit the size, amount or range of something

examples.x: Speed is restricted to 30 mph in towns.
We restrict the number of students per class to ten.
Fog severely restricted visibility.
Having small children tends to restrict your freedom.

senses.definition_vi: giới hạn kích thước, số lượng hoặc phạm vi của một cái gì đó

senses.definition: to stop somebody/something from moving or acting freely

examples.x: The long skirt restricted her movements.

senses.definition_vi: ngăn ai đó/cái gì đó di chuyển hoặc hành động tự do

senses.definition: to control something with rules or laws

examples.x: Access to the club is restricted to members only.

senses.definition_vi: kiểm soát một cái gì đó bằng các quy tắc hoặc luật pháp
